To locate an authorized Carlisle dealer near you, search our online distributor listing https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor.
paras.zh: Carlisle 的 EL121 系列盘式刹车片现已通过 Carlisle 授权经销商和分销商发售。要了解更多信息，请访问 https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el。要查找您附近的卡莱尔授权经销商，请搜索我们的在线经销商列表 https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是全球公认的高度创新制动和摩擦系统解决方案开发和制造领域的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。卡莱尔制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag

paras.en: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag
paras.zh: Carlisle 发布 Ag 视频突出显示解决方案

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction launches a new product solutions video: Carlisle Solutions for Tractor Applications, to showcase all of the latest motion control technologies available for agriculture equipment, specifically tractor applications.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司推出了新产品解决方案视频：卡莱尔拖拉机应用解决方案，展示适用于农业设备（特别是拖拉机应用）的所有最新运动控制技术。

paras.en: From power valves, to disc brakes, to PTO and shuttle clutch friction options, this video breaks down all of the features and benefits of Carlisle’s newest brake system and powertrain solutions.
paras.zh: 从动力阀到盘式制动器，再到取力器和梭式离合器摩擦选项，该视频详细介绍了卡莱尔最新制动系统和动力总成解决方案的所有功能和优点。

paras.en: For improved visualization, the video features 3D animation and demonstrations of the product fitments within a standard tractor model.
paras.zh: 为了提高可视化效果，该视频采用 3D 动画和标准拖拉机模型中的产品配件演示。

articles.title: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification

paras.en: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification
paras.zh: 卡莱苏州获得卡特彼勒 SER 认证

paras.en: (MEDINA, January 25, 2024) – Carlisle Brake & Friction announced its Suzhou facility has won a Supplier Excellence Recognition (SER) Certification from Caterpillar Inc. The Caterpillar SER is a new supplier management system featuring "Certified" and "Excellent" levels. Caterpillar officially launched the program in 2022. Carlisle's Suzhou manufacturing facility achieved a "Certified" level of recognition and celebrated the achievement alongside the Caterpillar team with a ceremony at the Carlisle Suzhou plant.
paras.zh: （梅迪纳，2024 年 1 月 25 日）——卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司宣布其苏州工厂获得卡特彼勒公司颁发的供应商卓越认可 (SER) 认证。卡特彼勒 SER 是一种新的供应商管理体系，具有“认证”和“优秀”级别。卡特彼勒于 2022 年正式启动该计划。卡莱尔苏州制造工厂获得了“认证”级别的认可，并与卡特彼勒团队在卡莱尔苏州工厂举行了仪式，庆祝这一成就。

paras.en: Of 27,000 suppliers, 250 were among the selected companies awarded by Caterpillar. Carlisle, a leading global supplier of brake, clutch, and transmission friction products, is the only friction products manufacturer worldwide to win the coveted certification.
paras.zh: 在 27,000 家供应商中，有 250 家入选卡特彼勒授予的奖项。 Carlisle 是全球领先的制动器、离合器和变速箱摩擦产品供应商，也是全球唯一一家获得这一令人垂涎的认证的摩擦产品制造商。

paras.en: "We are honored to be recognized by Caterpillar as a Certified level supplier," said Doug Wagner, Global VP of Sales, Carlisle Brake & Friction. "This award recognizes the superior efforts and dedication of the entire Suzhou team that supports our global business."
paras.zh: “我们很荣幸被 Caterpillar 认可为认证级供应商，”Carlisle 制动与摩擦部全球销售副总裁 Doug Wagner 说道。 “该奖项是对支持我们全球业务的整个苏州团队的卓越努力和奉献精神的认可。”

paras.en: Carlisle earned SER Certification in recognition of the company's exemplary commitment to supporting Caterpillar's global growth strategy goals.
paras.zh: Carlisle 获得了 SER 认证，以表彰该公司对支持 Caterpillar 全球增长战略目标的模范承诺。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是全球公认的高度创新制动和摩擦系统解决方案开发和制造领域的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。卡莱尔制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: Autel Partners with ALLDATA to Connect MaxiSYS Diagnostics with OEM Repair Information
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Autel U.S. has partnered with ALLDATA, a leading provider of original OEM repair information, to connect Autel’s MaxiSYS diagnostic software with ALLDATA Repair on MaxiSYS Ultra S2 and Ultra series tablets. This integration enables technicians to move directly from a vehicle fault code to the corresponding OEM diagnostic information, bringing scan results and OEM procedures together on one screen.
paras.zh: Autel U.S. 与原始 OEM 维修信息的领先提供商 ALLDATA 合作，将 Autel 的 MaxiSYS 诊断软件与 MaxiSYS Ultra S2 和 Ultra 系列平板电脑上的 ALLDATA Repair 连接起来。这种集成使技术人员能够直接从车辆故障代码转移到相应的 OEM 诊断信息，将扫描结果和 OEM 程序集中在一个屏幕上。

paras.en: Supported models include the MaxiSYS Ultra S2, MS919 S2 and MS909 S2, as well as the MaxiSYS Ultra, MS919, MS909, Ultra ADAS and Ultra EV.
paras.zh: 支持的型号包括 MaxiSYS Ultra S2、MS919 S2 和 MS909 S2，以及 MaxiSYS Ultra、MS919、MS909、Ultra ADAS 和 Ultra EV。

paras.en: Trusted by more than 400,000 technicians, ALLDATA provides access to original diagnostic and repair information supplied by vehicle manufacturers. ALLDATA Repair covers more than 44,000 engine-specific vehicles, representing approximately 95% of vehicles on the road. It includes OEM repair procedures, diagnostic flow charts, technical service bulletins, component locations, specifications and wiring diagrams.
paras.zh: ALLDATA 受到超过 400,000 名技术人员的信赖，提供对汽车制造商提供的原始诊断和维修信息的访问。 ALLDATA Repair 覆盖超过 44,000 辆发动机专用车辆，约占道路上车辆的 95%。它包括 OEM 维修程序、诊断流程图、技术服务公告、组件位置、规格和接线图。

paras.en: “Our partnership with Autel is another step toward creating a more connected diagnostic experience for technicians, when vehicles complexity is increasing,” said Satwinder Mangat, president of ALLDATA. “Bringing ALLDATA’s trusted OEM repair information into the diagnostic workflow helps technicians access the OEM information they need when and where they need it.”
paras.zh: ALLDATA 总裁 Satwinder Mangat 表示：“当车辆复杂性不断增加时，我们与 Autel 的合作是朝着为技术人员创造更加互联的诊断体验迈出的又一步。” “将 ALLDATA 值得信赖的 OEM 维修信息引入诊断工作流程可帮助技术人员随时随地访问所需的 OEM 信息。”

paras.en: Diagnostics and ALLDATA Repair Info. One Screen. Right at the Vehicle
paras.zh: 诊断和 ALLDATA 修复信息。一屏。就在车辆旁边

paras.en: The integration connects this extensive information resource with Autel’s diagnostic capabilities where technicians need it. From a fault code displayed in MaxiSYS, users can open the associated ALLDATA information for the selected vehicle and review OEM code descriptions, detection criteria, possible causes and diagnostic procedures. A split-screen view keeps the MaxiSYS diagnostic results visible alongside ALLDATA, allowing technicians to consult factory instructions without losing sight of the fault they are investigating.
paras.zh: 该集成将这种广泛的信息资源与技术人员需要的 Autel 诊断功能连接起来。从 MaxiSYS 中显示的故障代码中，用户可以打开所选车辆的相关 ALLDATA 信息，并查看 OEM 代码描述、检测标准、可能的原因和诊断程序。分屏视图使 MaxiSYS 诊断结果与 ALLDATA 一起可见，使技术人员能够查阅工厂说明，而不会忽视他们正在调查的故障。

paras.en: Technicians can then follow links within ALLDATA to related testing, removal and installation procedures, illustrations and service precautions. By carrying the vehicle and fault-code context into the repair information workflow, the integration reduces the need to search separately for the same vehicle and code. It helps technicians move more efficiently from diagnosis to repair. The integration also provides access to ALLDATA Diagnostic Intelligence, ALLDATA’s newest solution, combining OEM repair information, real-world repair intelligence and AI-assisted insights in one diagnostic workflow.
paras.zh: 然后，技术人员可以通过 ALLDATA 内的链接查看相关测试、拆卸和安装程序、插图和维修预防措施。通过将车辆和故障代码上下文纳入维修信息工作流程，集成减少了单独搜索相同车辆和代码的需要。它可以帮助技术人员更有效地从诊断到维修。该集成还提供对 ALLDATA 诊断智能的访问，这是 ALLDATA 的最新解决方案，它将 OEM 维修信息、实际维修智能和人工智能辅助见解结合在一个诊断工作流程中。

paras.en: “Finding a fault code is only the beginning. The next step is knowing how to test the system, identify the cause and perform the repair correctly,” said Chloe Hung, CEO of Autel U.S. “Connecting MaxiSYS diagnostics with ALLDATA’s OEM repair information gives technicians a direct path to those answers, right on the tablet they are already using at the vehicle.”
paras.zh: Autel 美国首席执行官 Chloe Hung 表示：“查找故障代码只是开始。下一步是了解如何测试系统、确定原因并正确执行维修。将 MaxiSYS 诊断与 ALLDATA 的 OEM 维修信息连接起来，技术人员可以直接在车辆上使用的平板电脑上找到这些答案。”

paras.en: - SEMA: South Hall Lower, booth no. 44175, and South Hall Upper, booth no. 38179
paras.zh: - SEMA：南厅下层，展位号。 44175，和南厅上层，展位号。 38179

paras.en: For more information on ALLDATA, visit alldata.com.
paras.zh: 有关 ALLDATA 的更多信息，请访问 alldata.com。

paras.en: For more information on Autel, visit autel.com.
paras.zh: 有关 Autel 的更多信息，请访问 autel.com。

articles.title: Shop of the Future: Why Alignment Belongs at the Beginning
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Welcome to our new “Shop of the Future” video series sponsored by Hunter Engineering.
paras.zh: 欢迎观看由 Hunter Engineering 赞助的新“未来商店”视频系列。

paras.en: A collision repair can look straightforward until the measurements say otherwise. That is why alignment should not be an end-of-job surprise. It should help uncover hidden damage, shape the repair plan and tell you what work may be waiting behind the visible damage. Keeping alignments in-house will have a dramatic effect on profitability, liability, quality control, cycle time efficiency and ADAS.
paras.zh: 碰撞修复看起来很简单，除非测量结果表明并非如此。这就是为什么调整不应该成为工作结束时的意外。它应该有助于发现隐藏的损坏、制定修复计划并告诉您可见损坏背后可能正在等待哪些工作。保持内部一致性将对盈利能力、责任、质量控制、周期时间效率和 ADAS 产生巨大影响。

paras.en: - Body and alignment measurements should be part of the intake process for identifying (often hidden) issues early with appropriate documentation
paras.zh: - 身体和体态测量应成为接收过程的一部分，以便通过适当的记录尽早识别（通常是隐藏的）问题

paras.en: - Collision alignment is not the same as general repair shop alignment
paras.zh: - 碰撞对准与一般维修店对准不同

paras.en: - How to develop a calibration and complex repair identification process
paras.zh: - 如何开发校准和复杂的维修识别流程

paras.en: - Liability risk of these repairs through outsourcing and its effect on profits
paras.zh: - 通过外包进行这些维修的责任风险及其对利润的影响

paras.en: - Why alignment is critically important as the gateway to ADAS
paras.zh: - 为什么对齐作为 ADAS 的门户至关重要

paras.en: To watch Part 1 of this series, click here.
paras.zh: 要观看本系列的第 1 部分，请单击此处。

articles.title: Partly Debuts PartlyRepair AI at SEMA 2026
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Partly, the Austin-based company building frontier AI for repair, has launched PartlyRepair AI at SEMA 2026. PartlyRepair AI is the agentic AI assistant for collision repair shops, powered by Interpreter, Partly’s proprietary AI model that understands and reasons across vehicles, parts and repair procedures. It automates the research and admin across the entire job, from intake and damage capture to procurement and job close.
paras.zh: Partly 是一家总部位于奥斯汀的公司，致力于打造前沿的维修人工智能，在 SEMA 2026 上推出了 PartlyRepair AI。PartlyRepair AI 是碰撞维修店的代理人工智能助手，由 Interpreter 提供支持，Interpreter 是 Partly 的专有人工智能模型，可以理解和推理车辆、零件和维修程序。它使整个工作的研究和管理自动化，从接收和损害捕获到采购和工作结束。

paras.en: In collision repair, the margin is in the details: a line left off the estimate, the wrong part for the trim, a supplement without the evidence to back it, a car waiting on parts. Each miss erodes margin and extends cycle time. PartlyRepair AI was shaped by conversations with more than 150 collision shops and is built to catch those mistakes before they cost the shop.
paras.zh: 在碰撞修复中，利润在于细节：估算中遗漏的一行、装饰的错误零件、没有证据支持的补充、等待零件的汽车。每次失误都会侵蚀利润并延长周期时间。 PartlyRepair AI 是通过与 150 多家碰撞维修店的对话而形成的，旨在在这些错误造成维修店损失之前发现这些错误。

paras.en: “Ask a shop owner where the day goes and you hear the same list: going back over estimates line by line, checking prices across supplier portals and chasing the documentation to get a supplement paid,” said Bill Lopez, senior vice president, Commercial, North America at Partly. “Every hour spent on that admin is an hour away from the cars in the bays. That’s the time PartlyRepair AI gives back.”
paras.zh: Partly 北美商业高级副总裁比尔·洛佩兹 (Bill Lopez) 表示：“询问店主这一天过得怎么样，你会听到同样的清单：逐行回顾估算，检查供应商门户网站上的价格，并追踪文件以获得补贴。” “在管理员身上花费的每一小时，就意味着远离车库里的汽车一个小时。这就是 PartlyRepair AI 回报的时间。”

paras.en: PartlyRepair AI already has six specialized agents live, with more to come. Shops see value across their workflows, including:
paras.zh: PartlyRepair AI 已经拥有 6 名专业代理，未来还会有更多代理。商店看到了整个工作流程的价值，包括：

paras.en: - Estimate review and optimization: right the first time. It helps estimators capture the context of each job, reviews the estimate against OEM procedures and flags operations and parts that are incorrect or may have been missed.
paras.zh: - 估算审核和优化：第一次就正确。它可以帮助估算人员了解每项工作的背景情况，根据 OEM 程序审查估算结果，并标记不正确或可能遗漏的操作和零件。

paras.en: - Parts procurement: the right order, found for you. It compares options across multiple suppliers, weighing price, speed and quality, to build the best parts order for each job, then takes the admin out of placing it.
paras.zh: - 零件采购：为您找到正确的订单。它会比较多个供应商的选择，权衡价格、速度和质量，为每项工作构建最佳的零件订单，然后让管理员不再需要下订单。

paras.en: - Job close: fewer loose ends. It reconciles invoices and follows up on credits owed, so the work done is the work billed.
paras.zh: - 工作结束：更少的未解决问题。它核对发票并跟踪欠款，因此完成的工作就是计费的工作。

paras.en: Interpreter is what sets PartlyRepair AI apart. Partly has spent six years training it, with a team that pairs AI researchers with experienced estimators, parts specialists and technicians. Interpreter draws on licensed OEM build sheets and data to answer vehicle-specific parts and repair questions on more than 1 million vehicle configurations. Interpreter is already at work in shops throughout New Zealand and the United Kingdom, where repairers using Partly’s platform order parts nine times faster and have 2.4 times fewer returns.
paras.zh: 解释器是 PartlyRepair AI 的与众不同之处。 Partly 花了六年时间对其进行培训，其团队由人工智能研究人员与经验丰富的估算员、零件专家和技术人员组成。 Interpreter 利用获得许可的 OEM 构建表和数据来回答超过 100 万种车辆配置的车辆特定零件和维修问题。 Interpreter 已经在新西兰和英国各地的商店中使用，使用 Partly 平台的维修人员订购零件的速度提高了 9 倍，退货率降低了 2.4 倍。

paras.en: “General-purpose AI can read an estimate. But understanding what a specific vehicle actually needs to be repaired is a different problem,” said Levi Fawcett, CEO of Partly. “We’ve spent six years building the intelligence to solve that problem. Now we’re putting it directly in the hands of repairers, helping them protect their margins while keeping them in control of every decision.”
paras.zh: Partly 首席执行官 Levi Fawcett 表示：“通用人工智能可以读取估算值。但了解特定车辆实际需要维修的内容则是另一个问题。” “我们花了六年时间构建情报来解决这个问题。现在我们将其直接交给维修人员，帮助他们保护利润，同时让他们控制每一个决定。”

paras.en: Partly is an AI research company building frontier AI for repair, starting with automotive. Its frontier model, Interpreter, is trained on billions of lines of parts and build sheet data, backed by agreements with more than 50 vehicle manufacturers, to understand and reason across vehicles, parts and repair procedures. Interpreter powers PartlyRepair AI for repair shops and PartlyLabs for repair networks, parts suppliers and enterprises. Partly has more than 220 employees, headquarters in Austin, Texas, and offices in San Francisco, London, Christchurch and Auckland. In 2026, it raised a $50 million Series B led by DST Global at a $500 million valuation.
paras.zh: Partly 是一家人工智能研究公司，从汽车行业开始构建前沿人工智能修复技术。其前沿模型 Interpreter 经过数十亿行零件和构建表数据的训练，并得到与 50 多家汽车制造商达成协议的支持，可以理解和推理车辆、零件和维修程序。 Interpreter 为维修店提供 PartlyRepair AI，为维修网络、零部件供应商和企业提供 PartlyLabs。 Partly 拥有 220 多名员工，总部位于德克萨斯州奥斯汀，并在旧金山、伦敦、基督城和奥克兰设有办事处。 2026年，它以5亿美元的估值筹集了由DST Global领投的5000万美元B轮融资。

articles.title: Tennessee denies Scout Motors direct sales dealer license application
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: The Tennessee Motor Vehicle Commission denied Scout Motors a direct-to-customer dealer license last week, citing the company’s ownership structure as violating state law that prohibits competition with an OEM’s franchise dealers.
paras.zh: 田纳西州机动车辆委员会上周拒绝向 Scout Motors 颁发直接面向客户的经销商许可证，称该公司的所有权结构违反了禁止与 OEM 特许经销商竞争的州法律。

paras.en: According to the commission, multiple Volkswagen dealers in Tennessee oppose Scout selling its vehicles in the state because they contend Volkswagen owns the company, which already sells its vehicles there.
paras.zh: 据该委员会称，田纳西州的多家大众汽车经销商反对 Scout 在该州销售其汽车，因为他们认为大众汽车公司拥有该公司，而该公司已经在那里销售其汽车。

paras.en: The commission asked Scout representatives about ownership, who said Volkswagen AG is an investor, but Scout is its own manufacturer. Sara Ash, Scout’s litigation associate general counsel, said the automaker is “funded 100% by Volkswagen AG.”
paras.zh: 该委员会询问了 Scout 代表有关所有权的问题，他们表示大众汽车公司是投资者，但 Scout 是自己的制造商。 Scout 诉讼副总法律顾问萨拉·阿什 (Sara Ash) 表示，该汽车制造商“100% 由大众汽车公司提供资金”。

paras.en: Sym Singh, Scout’s state government affairs director, said Volkswagen AG is a publicly traded German company while Volkswagen Group of America is a U.S.-licensed manufacturer and distributor of Volkswagen vehicles. Singh said Scout doesn’t have ties to the latter.
paras.zh: 斯考特州政府事务总监西姆·辛格(Sym Singh)表示，大众汽车公司是一家德国上市公司，而大众汽车集团美国公司是一家获得美国许可的大众汽车制造商和经销商。辛格表示，斯考特与后者没有任何关系。

paras.en: “We have ties to the folks who are publicly traded in Germany who have invested in us,” he said. “We have designed, engineered, and we are building our vehicles separate from any other Volkswagen entity… We have designed these models. We have built them. We have the IP [intellectual property] for them. We have the technology for them. They are our vehicles, and Audi of America and Volkswagen of America, they do not have rights to those vehicles.”
paras.zh: “我们与投资我们的德国上市公司有联系，”他说。 “我们设计、制造并制造我们的车辆，与任何其他大众实体分开……我们设计了这些车型。我们制造了它们。我们拥有它们的IP（知识产权）。我们拥有它们的技术。它们是我们的车辆，而美国奥迪和美国大众，他们对这些车辆没有权利。”

paras.en: Singh argued that Tennessee law prohibits a manufacturer from competing with an existing dealer of the same line make in the relevant market area; however, “there are no Scout dealers in Tennessee, not one,” he said.
paras.zh: 辛格辩称，田纳西州法律禁止制造商与相关市场区域内同类产品的现有经销商竞争；然而，“田纳西州没有童子军经销商，一个也没有，”他说。

paras.en: “Scout is a distinct automotive brand,” he said. “Volkswagen dealerships don’t sell Scout vehicles. Audi dealerships don’t sell Scout vehicles. And corporate affiliation does not somehow transform those dealerships into Scout dealerships.”
paras.zh: “Scout 是一个独特的汽车品牌，”他说。 “大众汽车经销店不销售 Scout 车辆。奥迪经销店也不销售 Scout 车辆。企业隶属关系并不会以某种方式将这些经销店转变为 Scout 经销店。”

paras.en: Scout is building a $2 billion production center in South Carolina, which Singh said is almost complete. He told the commission the center is slated for full production by the end of 2027, with vehicle delivery to customers planned for 2028.
paras.zh: Scout 正在南卡罗来纳州建造一个耗资 20 亿美元的生产中心，Singh 表示该中心已基本完工。他告诉委员会，该中心计划于 2027 年底全面投产，并计划于 2028 年向客户交付车辆。

paras.en: Before the commission voted, Singh said Scout applied for a Tennessee dealer license in March, ahead of when its vehicles would hit the road so it could connect with potential Tennessee customers.
paras.zh: 辛格表示，在委员会投票之前，Scout 在 3 月份申请了田纳西州经销商许可证，随后其车辆将上路，以便与潜在的田纳西州客户建立联系。

paras.en: “We are starting our build-out and our licensure in states around the country now so that consumers have that known place that they can take their vehicle once they purchase it,” Singh said.
paras.zh: 辛格说：“我们现在正在全国各州开始扩建和发放许可证，以便消费者在购买车辆后可以在一个已知的地方取车。”

paras.en: He added that once licensed in a state, potential customers can get information from Scout about its vehicles, including cost.
paras.zh: 他补充说，一旦在某个州获得许可，潜在客户就可以从 Scout 获得有关其车辆的信息，包括成本。

paras.en: “In states that we’re not licensed in, and we’re not allowed to sell in, we’re not sometimes allowed to talk about those things,” Singh said. “We have consumers in those states that really would like us to be able to engage with them… Consumers are demanding, and they should be. They should hold us accountable, and they should want more from us.”
paras.zh: 辛格说：“在我们没有获得许可、不允许销售的州，我们有时不被允许谈论这些事情。” “这些州的消费者确实希望我们能够与他们互动……消费者的要求很高，他们应该这样做。他们应该让我们承担责任，他们应该希望我们提供更多。”

paras.en: Nick Bader, an attorney who spoke on behalf of Volkswagen dealers in Tennessee, told the commission, “By being asked to grant Scout Motor Sales a dealer license, you are faced with a key question: can a car manufacturer that already sells through Tennessee dealers open its own dealership just by putting the store in the name of a subsidiary? The answer is no. Nothing about this application changes that. Scout is Volkswagen. They’re not part of a new entrant to the automotive space.”
paras.zh: 代表田纳西州大众汽车经销商发言的律师尼克·巴德 (Nick Bader) 告诉委员会，“当您被要求向 Scout Motor Sales 授予经销商许可证时，您将面临一个关键问题：已经通过田纳西州经销商进行销售的汽车制造商是否可以仅通过将商店以子公司的名义开设自己的经销店？答案是否定的。此应用程序不会改变这一点。Scout 是大众汽车。他们不是汽车领域新进入者的一部分。”

paras.en: Singh argued that the commission previously approved dealer applications involving manufacturing-affiliated sales entities, including Tesla and Rivian, “both of whom have automotive investment from companies that many of you are dealers of.”
paras.zh: 辛格辩称，该委员会此前批准了涉及制造附属销售实体的经销商申请，包括特斯拉和 Rivian，“这两家公司都拥有来自你们许多人都是其经销商的公司的汽车投资。”

paras.en: “We are asking for the same fair and consistent application of Tennessee’s licensing standards, the law that’s on the books,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们要求同样公平和一致地应用田纳西州的许可标准，即书面法律，”他说。

paras.en: Scout also faced opposition in Colorado over its direct sales model, and was ultimately granted a dealer license.
paras.zh: Scout 的直销模式在科罗拉多州也面临反对，但最终获得了经销商许可证。

paras.en: Featured image: The Scout Terra (Provided by Scout Motors)
paras.zh: 特色图片：Scout Terra（由 Scout Motors 提供）

articles.title: Toyota Kentucky gave $1.4 million in educational and workforce grants this year
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Toyota Kentucky has awarded $1.4 million in educational and workforce training grants this year to nonprofit organizations across Central Kentucky, according to a press release.
paras.zh: 据一份新闻稿称，丰田肯塔基州今年已向肯塔基州中部的非营利组织提供 140 万美元的教育和劳动力培训补助金。

paras.en: The grants support hands-on STEM education, mentoring, workforce training and career placement programs, the release adds. Toyota Kentucky says the programs help to equip students and job seekers with the skills, experience and opportunities they need to succeed.
paras.zh: 新闻稿补充说，这些赠款支持实践 STEM 教育、指导、劳动力培训和职业安置计划。丰田肯塔基州表示，这些项目有助于为学生和求职者提供成功所需的技能、经验和机会。

paras.en: “When students can see a future for themselves, incredible things happen,” said David Fernandes, Toyota Kentucky president. “We’ve seen young people progress from robotics competitions and mentoring programs to college classrooms and on to rewarding careers. That’s the kind of long-term impact these investments create.”
paras.zh: 丰田肯塔基州总裁戴维·费尔南德斯 (David Fernandes) 表示：“当学生能够看到自己的未来时，不可思议的事情就会发生。” “我们看到年轻人从机器人竞赛和辅导项目到大学课堂，再到有价值的职业。这就是这些投资所产生的长期影响。”

paras.en: The automaker says that in celebration of its largest plant’s 40th anniversary, it has recognized four organizations with special $40,000 grants.
paras.zh: 该汽车制造商表示，为了庆祝其最大工厂成立 40 周年，它向四家组织提供了 4 万美元的特别赠款。

paras.en: “Big Brothers Big Sisters of the Bluegrass helps empower young people through transformative mentoring relationships.
paras.zh: “蓝草大兄弟大姐妹通过变革性的指导关系帮助年轻人增强能力。

paras.en: “AMEN House addresses food insecurity and helps students and families navigate times of need.
paras.zh: “AMEN House 解决粮食不安全问题，帮助学生和家庭度过有需要的时期。

paras.en: “Jubilee Jobs of Lexington connects people with meaningful employment through workforce training and career support.
paras.zh: “列克星敦的 Jubilee Jobs 通过劳动力培训和职业支持为人们提供有意义的就业机会。

paras.en: “Kentucky FIRST Robotics prepares students for future careers through hands-on STEM and robotics experiences.”
paras.zh: “肯塔基州 FIRST Robotics 通过实践 STEM 和机器人技术经验，为学生未来的职业生涯做好准备。”

paras.en: The organizations help young people build confidence, support families through challenging times and connect Kentuckians with educational and career opportunities that strengthen the region’s workforce, the release states.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，这些组织帮助年轻人建立信心，支持家庭度过充满挑战的时期，并为肯塔基州人提供教育和职业机会，以增强该地区的劳动力。

paras.en: “Every student deserves the opportunity to see themselves as an innovator and leader,” said Kelli Gowan, KY FIRST Robotics executive director, in the release. “Toyota Kentucky’s support helps open doors for young people across Kentucky by giving them hands-on experiences that build the technical and teamwork skills that they need for the future.”
paras.zh: KY FIRST Robotics 执行董事 Kelli Gowan 在新闻稿中表示：“每个学生都应该有机会将自己视为创新者和领导者。” “丰田肯塔基州的支持为肯塔基州的年轻人打开了大门，为他们提供实践经验，培养他们未来所需的技术和团队合作技能。”

paras.en: Toyota Kentucky has invested more than $166 million in the state since it was created in 1986, according to the release.
paras.zh: 据新闻稿称，自 1986 年创建以来，丰田肯塔基州已在该州投资超过 1.66 亿美元。

articles.title: TechForce CEO warns collision industry risks being left behind in skilled trades workforce push
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: The pendulum is swinging, and major corporations with deep pockets are discussing the skilled workforce shortage, but that also means competition for a seat at the table will intensify, Jennifer Maher, TechForce Foundation CEO, told Repairer Driven News.
paras.zh: TechForce 基金会首席执行官 Jennifer Maher 告诉 Repairer Driven News，钟摆正在摆动，财力雄厚的大公司正在讨论熟练劳动力短缺问题，但这也意味着争夺席位的竞争将会加剧。

paras.en: “I worry that I don’t hear that same momentum in the collision industry,” Maher said.
paras.zh: “我担心我在碰撞行业中没有听到同样的势头，”马赫说。

paras.en: The U.S.Bureau of Labor has identified 47 different technician jobs using its standard occupational classification (SOC) system, Maher said. She said this includes everything from wind turbine techs to elevator technicians.
paras.zh: 马赫表示，美国劳工局利用其标准职业分类 (SOC) 系统确定了 47 种不同的技术人员职位。她说，这包括从风力涡轮机技术到电梯技术人员的一切。

paras.en: “We’re all competing for the same person,” Maher said. “The person who is curious, likes to problem solve, takes it apart and puts it back together, gets a thrill out of making things work.”
paras.zh: “我们都在为同一个人竞争，”马赫说。 “充满好奇心的人喜欢解决问题，将问题拆开再组装起来，并从让事情顺利进行中获得乐趣。”

paras.en: The collision industry competes with all of these different technician sectors, she said. The industry is also competing with all of the skilled trades, which include electricians, construction workers and plumbers.
paras.zh: 她说，碰撞行业与所有​​这些不同的技术部门竞争。该行业还与所有技术行业竞争，包括电工、建筑工人和水管工。

paras.en: “You can’t just look at how to build collision techs in the collision program,” Maher said. “You have to cast your net really wide. We’re competing with all of those sectors.”
paras.zh: “你不能只关注如何在碰撞程序中构建碰撞技术，”马赫说。 “你必须把网撒得很广。我们正在与所有这些行业竞争。”

paras.en: Technicians are often overlooked in the conversation, she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，技术人员在谈话中经常被忽视。

paras.en: “I call them our hidden heroes because we all need technicians and we need to recognize and start talking about the importance of those service and maintenance technicians,” Maher said.
paras.zh: “我称他们为隐藏的英雄，因为我们都需要技术人员，我们需要认识到并开始谈论这些服务和维护技术人员的重要性，”马赫说。

paras.en: As the pendulum swings, the conversation is heavily focused on construction jobs.
paras.zh: 随着钟摆的摆动，谈话主要集中在建筑工作上。

paras.en: “I appreciate the need to bring back manufacturing and build more plants, build more housing, and build more data centers. That’s exciting and great, but in my world, I’m asking how do we keep what we have moving?”
paras.zh: “我意识到有必要恢复制造业，建造更多工厂，建造更多住房，建造更多数据中心。这令人兴奋且伟大，但在我的世界里，我问的是我们如何保持我们现有的运转？”

paras.en: If technicians get lost in the conversation, then people will find themselves waiting on the tarmac because of a shortage of airplane technicians or waiting two months for their vehicle to be repaired because of a shortage of auto technicians, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，如果技术人员在谈话中迷失了方向，那么人们会发现自己因为飞机技术人员短缺而在停机坪上等待，或者因为汽车技术人员短缺而等待两个月才能修理车辆。

paras.en: “Techs are important and we need to be at the table,” Maher said. “That’s the bottom line, technicians need to be in the headlines and they need to be part of the excitement around the skilled trades.”
paras.zh: “技术很重要，我们需要参与其中，”马赫说。 “这是底线，技术人员需要成为头条新闻，他们需要成为技术行业令人兴奋的一部分。”

paras.en: The top 10 technician fields identified by the U.S. Bureau of Labor adds up to a workforce of 7 million people, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，美国劳工局确定的十大技术领域的劳动力总数为 700 万人。

paras.en: “Collectively they are a huge force but they are buried, hidden and not talked about,” Maher said.
paras.zh: 马赫说：“总的来说，他们是一股巨大的力量，但他们被埋葬、隐藏起来，没有被谈论。”

paras.en: Even under the Bureau of Labor’s classification system, technicians are scattered throughout different industries including transportation, energy, industrial manufacturing and construction, she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，即使根据劳工局的分类制度，技术人员也分散在不同行业，包括交通、能源、工业制造和建筑。

paras.en: TechForce’s “Technician Supply, Demand & Opportunity Report.” found the U.S. economy is short roughly 140,000 skilled technicians a year, and the gap is widening, with 73,354 new collision repair entrant technicians needed by 2029.
paras.zh: TechForce 的“技术人员供应、需求和机会报告”。研究发现，美国经济每年大约短缺 14 万名熟练技术人员，而且缺口还在扩大，到 2029 年需要 73,354 名新的碰撞维修技术人员。

paras.en: It found that the collision repair sector sees the highest turnover of the 10 analyzed at 60.7%.
paras.zh: 调查发现，在分析的 10 个行业中，碰撞维修行业的营业额最高，达到 60.7%。

paras.en: Maher said TechForce Foundation continuously polls its 125,000 aspiring working techs to see which industries excite them.
paras.zh: Maher 表示，TechForce 基金会不断对其 125,000 名有抱负的技术人员进行民意调查，看看哪些行业让他们感兴趣。

paras.en: “I am worried about the collision industry because it does not resonate above the fold,” Maher said. “It is way down, way down on the list.”
paras.zh: “我对碰撞行业感到担忧，因为它不会引起大众的共鸣，”马赫说。 “它在名单上排名靠后，非常靠后。”

paras.en: That is going to be a recruiting challenge for the collision industry, she adds.
paras.zh: 她补充道，这对于碰撞行业来说将是一个招聘挑战。

paras.en: “It is a supply and demand economy,” Maher said. “When you look at wages, it’s not at the top. If it’s the same type of person and they start to learn their options, thanks to AI now, they can just ask. In the past, they didn’t know how to compare and they weren’t going to do that much research.”
paras.zh: “这是一个供需经济，”马赫说。 “当你看工资时，你会发现它并不是最高的。如果是同一类型的人，他们开始了解自己的选择，感谢现在的人工智能，他们只需询问即可。过去，他们不知道如何比较，也不会做那么多研究。”

paras.en: For every 10 collision techs needed, schools are only producing four, Maher states.
paras.zh: 马赫表示，每需要 10 名碰撞技术人员，学校只能培养 4 名。

paras.en: “That leaves us more than 8,000 techs short every year, and what scares me most is that 6 in 10 leave their job every year,” Maher says. “Retention is just as big of an issue as recruitment.”
paras.zh: “这使得我们每年短缺 8,000 多名技术人员，最让我害怕的是每年有十分之六的人离职，”马赫说。 “留住人才和招聘一样都是一个大问题。”

paras.en: Ford is one catalyst swinging the pendulum and auto and collision technicians have been a part of that conversation.
paras.zh: 福特是推动这一趋势的催化剂之一，汽车和碰撞技术人员也参与了这场对话。

paras.en: CEO Jim Farley launched the ACCELERATE The Essential Economy event last year to start the conversation. It was held again last month.
paras.zh: 首席执行官吉姆·法利（Jim Farley）去年发起了“加速基本经济”活动来开启对话。上个月再次举行。

paras.en: Through the event, the Alliance for America’s Skilled Trades was started and the State of America’s Skilled Trades: A National Report was funded.
paras.zh: 通过该活动，美国技术行业联盟成立，并为《美国技术行业状况：国家报告》提供了资金。

paras.en: The Alliance has brought together major companies such as BlackRock, Google, Carhartt, NVIDIA, Microsoft and Milwaukee Tool to fund initiatives focused on the shortage.
paras.zh: 该联盟汇集了 BlackRock、Google、Carhartt、NVIDIA、Microsoft 和 Milwaukee Tool 等主要公司，为针对短缺问题的举措提供资金。

paras.en: The State of America’s Skilled Trades report found the employment growth rate for automotive body and related repair to be 0.6% between 2019 and 2025.
paras.zh: 美国技术行业报告发现，2019 年至 2025 年间，汽车车身及相关维修行业的就业增长率为 0.6%。

paras.en: It also found that Auto body and other related repairers rank 118 out of 525 other occupations facing national shortage pressure.
paras.zh: 调查还发现，汽车车身及其他相关维修工在全国面临短缺压力的525个其他职业中排名第118位。

paras.en: “Ford is looking at industrial manufacturing, who is repairing the conveyor belt, the robotic techs. And Ford dealerships are all over the country,” Maher said. “They know their product and their consumer and the challenges when it comes to hiring boots on the ground. Which is why they’re investing in solutions”
paras.zh: “福特正在关注工业制造，谁正在修理传送带和机器人技术。福特经销商遍布全国，”马赫说。 “他们了解自己的产品、消费者，以及在现场招聘员工时面临的挑战。这就是他们投资解决方案的原因”

paras.en: Ford Motor Company and Ford Philanthropy make up TechForce’s largest donor at $4.5 million.
paras.zh: 福特汽车公司和福特慈善机构是 TechForce 的最大捐助者，捐赠金额达 450 万美元。

paras.en: “They support scholarships for people to become auto tech with no strings attached, “ Maher said. “It’s not like you have to go and work for Ford.”
paras.zh: “他们支持为人们提供奖学金，让他们成为无附加条件的汽车技术人员，”马赫说。 “这并不是说你必须去福特工作。”

paras.en: Ford has been at the forefront of having a strategy and a plan for the shortage, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，福特一直处于制定短缺战略和计划的最前沿。

paras.en: This includes Ford addressing the transportation issues that make a student dropout through a partnership with Lyft.
paras.zh: 其中包括福特通过与 Lyft 合作解决导致学生辍学的交通问题。

paras.en: Other OEMs are also working on the issue but everybody needs to invest to get students to the finish line, she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，其他原始设备制造商也在解决这个问题，但每个人都需要投资才能让学生到达终点线。

paras.en: “It is not just enough to change or enhance curriculum; people want faster, shorter ways to earn the credentials or training and get to work,” Maher said. “How do we accelerate that learning? How do we have more apprenticeships because retention continues to be a hurdle, especially in the collision industry?”
paras.zh: “仅仅改变或加强课程是不够的；人们希望以更快、更短的方式获得证书或培训并开始工作，”马赫说。 “我们如何加速学习？我们如何拥有更多学徒，因为保留仍然是一个障碍，特别是在碰撞行业？”

paras.en: TechForce believes students need to understand what the job really entails and that is through job shadowing, apprenticeships and a day in the life content.
paras.zh: TechForce 认为，学生需要了解这份工作的真正含义，即通过工作见习、学徒期和一天的生活内容。

paras.en: The organization is working on building AI tools for Gen Z so they can receive the information in a way that they want it.
paras.zh: 该组织正在致力于为 Z 世代构建人工智能工具，以便他们能够以自己想要的方式接收信息。

paras.en: “We also have to help students throughout the workforce journey, through that funnel,” Maher said. “It’s not enough for TechForce to give them a scholarship and wish them well. There are so many other challenges: transportation, childcare, food insecurity. Life happens.”
paras.zh: 马赫说：“我们还必须通过这个渠道，在整个劳动力旅程中帮助学生。” “TechForce 仅仅为他们提供奖学金并祝愿他们一切顺利是不够的。还有很多其他挑战：交通、儿童保育、粮食不安全。生活会发生。”

paras.en: Five-hundred dollars is the difference between keeping them in school or them getting derailed, Maher adds.
paras.zh: 马赫补充道，五百美元是让他们留在学校还是出轨的区别。

paras.en: During the ACCELERATE event, Farley also pointed to data from the new report that shows high-quality apprenticeships that include apprentice support are more likely to lead more workers into the economy.
paras.zh: 在加速活动期间，法利还指出了新报告中的数据，该数据显示包括学徒支持在内的高质量学徒制更有可能引导更多工人进入经济领域。

paras.en: The report found traditional training methods had only about a 50% completion rate. It also found that high-quality apprenticeship programs have a completion rate of more than 90%.
paras.zh: 报告发现，传统培训方法的完成率只有 50% 左右。调查还发现，高质量学徒计划的完成率超过 90%。

paras.en: ”We need the social programs to help and support, and we need the programs to be accredited and we need employers to be connected to these apprenticeships so that the people have a job,” Farley said.
paras.zh: 法利说：“我们需要社会计划来帮助和支持，我们需要这些计划得到认可，我们需要雇主与这些学徒计划建立联系，以便人们找到工作。”

paras.en: This is one way that collision shops can be a part of the solution, Maher said. A $500 donation could help one more student make their way through the program.
paras.zh: 马赫说，这是碰撞车间成为解决方案一部分的一种方式。捐款 500 美元可以帮助多一名学生完成该计划。

paras.en: “I truly believe if everybody isn’t a part of the solution, then they’re going to be part of the problem,” Maher said. “I have attended conferences and tried to let the collision industry know that TechForce is here and what we do. Yet, after three years, we have only two donors: LKQ and OEM Collision Roundtable.”
paras.zh: 马赫说：“我坚信，如果每个人都不是解决方案的一部分，那么他们就会成为问题的一部分。” “我参加过会议，并试图让碰撞行业知道 TechForce 在这里以及我们在做什么。然而，三年后，我们只有两个捐助者：LKQ 和 OEM Collision Roundtable。”

paras.en: Maher says that the collision industry is very generous to other educational programs that don’t provide scholarships to students or help them learn durable skills or get jobs.
paras.zh: 马赫表示，碰撞行业对其他教育项目非常慷慨，这些项目不向学生提供奖学金或帮助他们学习持久技能或找到工作。

paras.en: “They don’t get the students through the funnel and into industry careers,” Maher said.
paras.zh: “他们没有让学生通过渠道进入行业职业生涯，”马赫说。

paras.en: The industry needs to diversify its contributions for the best result, she adds.
paras.zh: 她补充说，该行业需要多样化贡献才能获得最佳结果。

paras.en: “That would be my challenge to the industry. Ford and others are looking at multiple ways to solve the problem and it is not a one-hit wonder,” Maher said.
paras.zh: “这将是我对整个行业的挑战。福特和其他公司正在寻找多种方法来解决这个问题，这并不是一击即成的奇迹，”马赫说。

paras.en: During the ACCELERATE event, Maher told the crowd that the organization has 125,000 students in its network who want to become professional skilled technicians.
paras.zh: 在 ACCELERATE 活动期间，Maher 告诉人群，该组织的网络中有 125,000 名希望成为专业技术人员的学生。

paras.en: “I used to award 1 in every 6 scholarships; the demand is rising now to 1 in every 10,” Maher
paras.zh: “我过去每 6 份奖学金中就有 1 份获得奖学金；现在需求上升到每 10 份就有 1 份，”马赫

paras.en: said. “The people want to do the work, but they need some support for that one year or so to get trained so that you can hire them or find that you exist. The fact is that TechForce has more demand from aspiring technicians than we have money to support. That is an investment worth
paras.zh: 说。 “人们想做这项工作，但他们需要一年左右的支持来接受培训，以便你可以雇用他们或发现你的存在。事实是，TechForce 对有抱负的技术人员的需求比我们有资金支持的要多。这是一项值得投资的投资

paras.en: making. They are already here; help us get them to you.”
paras.zh: 制作。他们已经在这里了；帮助我们把它们交给你。”

paras.en: Collision shops can individually be a part of the solution by contributing in a few ways, Maher said.
paras.zh: 马赫说，碰撞车间可以通过多种方式单独成为解决方案的一部分。

paras.en: A $1,200 a year donation supports a Boys and Girls Club of America dinner. This allows shops to say they are a TechForce champion and allows them to go into area schools that have the program, she said.
paras.zh: 每年捐款 1,200 美元支持美国男孩女孩俱乐部的晚宴。她说，这让商店可以说他们是 TechForce 的冠军，并允许他们进入有该项目的地区学校。

paras.en: A $12,500 donation can fund a named scholarship in your community, Maher adds. Shops are able to see tuition scholarships go to aspiring techs at their area schools and volunteer locally, she said. You can meet your awardees, and promote their success through local papers with the help of TechForce.
paras.zh: Maher 补充道，12,500 美元的捐款可以资助您所在社区的一项指定奖学金。她说，商店可以看到学费奖学金发放给当地学校有抱负的技术人员和当地志愿者。您可以与获奖者见面，并在 TechForce 的帮助下通过当地报纸宣传他们的成功。

paras.en: The scholarship can also be promoted through local papers with the help of TechForce.
paras.zh: 该奖学金还可以在 TechForce 的帮助下通过当地报纸进行推广。

paras.en: To help recruit technicians, shops should also look at their culture.
paras.zh: 为了帮助招聘技术人员，商店还应该看看他们的文化。

paras.en: Gen Z is a gaming generation, Maher said. They need a plan to level up.
paras.zh: 马赫表示，Z 世代是游戏一代。他们需要一个升级计划。

paras.en: ”Have a career path mapped out for people,” Maher said. “We have an entry-level position. We make sure you can perfect A, B, and C. When we see you can accomplish and master those skills, we move you to level B.”
paras.zh: “为人们制定职业道路，”马赫说。 “我们有一个入门级职位。我们确保您能够完善 A、B 和 C。当我们看到您能够完成并掌握这些技能时，我们会将您提升到 B 级。”

paras.en: Shops should also look at their atmosphere.
paras.zh: 商店还应该看看他们的气氛。

paras.en: “It’s a supply and demand economy,” Maher said. “They can pick and choose. So what’s your pay? Do you have air conditioning or not? Do you make women wear boxy male uniforms?”
paras.zh: “这是一个供需经济，”马赫说。 “他们可以挑选。那你的工资是多少？有空调吗？你让女人穿四四方方的男制服吗？”

paras.en: Maher said another culture change would be to actively welcome women.
paras.zh: 马赫表示，另一种文化变革是积极欢迎女性。

paras.en: “Women are less than 4% of technicians across the trades,” Maher said. “If you want to solve a shortage, welcome to 50% of the population.”
paras.zh: “在各行业的技术人员中，女性所占比例不到 4%，”马赫说道。 “如果你想解决短缺问题，欢迎50%的人口加入。”

paras.en: Women are more likely to graduate college than men but men are more likely to graduate trade school, Maher added.
paras.zh: 马赫补充说，女性比男性更有可能从大学毕业，但男性更有可能从贸易学校毕业。

paras.en: “Why?” Maher said. “It’s called self-doubt. When you are the only female in the classroom and you are getting harassed, you’re like, ‘I’m out of here. I don’t belong.’ Create a sense of belonging. Ensure they feel supported. Have a female tech be part of the interview, then women would see themselves in the industry.”
paras.zh: “为什么？”马赫说。 “这就是自我怀疑。当你是教室里唯一的女性并且受到骚扰时，你会想，‘我离开这里了。我不属于这里。’创造一种归属感。确保他们感到支持。让一位女性技术人员参与面试，然后女性就会在这个行业中看到自己。”

paras.en: The industry should also tap into what makes it unique, Maher said.
paras.zh: 马赫表示，该行业还应该挖掘其独特之处。

paras.en: She explained how TechForce did a public service announcement for the collision industry a couple years ago, interviewing collision students for the script. The word students continued to use was “art.”
paras.zh: 她解释了 TechForce 几年前如何为碰撞行业发布公益公告，采访碰撞学生以撰写剧本。学生们继续使用的词是“艺术”。

paras.en: Students said they loved that they took a crashed vehicle and put it back together.
paras.zh: 学生们表示，他们喜欢将一辆撞毁的车辆重新组装起来。

paras.en: ”There is pride in that work,” Maher said.
paras.zh: “这项工作让人感到自豪，”马赫说。

paras.en: The video is free for any collision shop to download and share to promote the profession, she adds.
paras.zh: 她补充说，该视频可供任何碰撞商店免费下载和分享，以宣传该行业。

paras.en: Shops overall may feel helpless because they haven’t seen a return on investment when donating to workforce causes.
paras.zh: 总体而言，商店可能会感到无助，因为他们在为劳动力事业捐款时没有看到投资回报。

paras.en: “I encourage them to look at multiple solutions–various organizations– because it is really not a one-hit wonder,” Maher said. “A lot of us have to do different pieces to make a dent.”
paras.zh: “我鼓励他们考虑多种解决方案——不同的组织——因为这确实不是一击即成的奇迹，”马赫说。 “我们很多人都必须做不同的事情才能有所作为。”

paras.en: Feature image of Jennifer Maher, TechForce Foundation CEO, at ACCELERATE courtesy of TechForce Foundation.
paras.zh: TechForce 基金会首席执行官 Jennifer Maher 在 ACCELERATE 上的特写图片由 TechForce 基金会提供。

articles.title: Bad TPMS Sensor or ID Mismatch? Autel Shows How to Check
articles.author: Tomorrow's Technician Staff

paras.en: A TPMS warning light doesn’t automatically mean a sensor needs replacing. The problem could be a failing sensor, a communication issue or a sensor ID mismatch that requires a relearn. Identifying the cause before starting the repair can save time and unnecessary work.
paras.zh: TPMS 警告灯并不自动意味着传感器需要更换。问题可能是传感器故障、通信问题或需要重新学习的传感器 ID 不匹配。在开始维修之前查明原因可以节省时间和不必要的工作。

paras.en: In Episode 1 of this five-part TPMS series, we look at Autel‘s “Test. Know. Go.” approach to TPMS service and how Autel TPMS tools guide technicians through diagnosis, sensor replacement, relearn procedures and final verification.
paras.zh: 在这个由五部分组成的 TPMS 系列的第一集中，我们将了解 Autel 的“测试、了解、执行”。 TPMS 服务方法以及 Autel TPMS 工具如何指导技术人员进行诊断、传感器更换、重新学习程序和最终验证。

paras.en: The process begins with sensor activation. In less than a minute, an Autel TPMS tool can retrieve each sensor’s ID, tire pressure, temperature, battery condition and communication status. Connecting to the vehicle allows the tool to compare those readings with information stored in the TPMS control module.
paras.zh: 该过程从传感器激活开始。在不到一分钟的时间内，Autel TPMS 工具就可以检索每个传感器的 ID、轮胎压力、温度、电池状况和通信状态。连接到车辆后，该工具可以将这些读数与 TPMS 控制模块中存储的信息进行比较。

paras.en: A color-coded display helps technicians identify failed or failing sensors and ID mismatches, providing a clearer picture of the problem before removing a wheel or replacing a component.
paras.zh: 颜色编码显示屏可帮助技术人员识别故障或故障传感器以及 ID 不匹配，从而在拆卸车轮或更换组件之前提供更清晰的问题图片。

paras.en: When replacement is necessary, Autel’s programmable 1-Sensor provides another option. According to Autel, the sensor offers 99.9% coverage across domestic, Asian and European passenger vehicle applications, helping shops reduce the number of replacement sensors they need to stock.
paras.zh: 当需要更换时，Autel 的可编程 1-Sensor 提供了另一种选择。据 Autel 称，该传感器在国内、亚洲和欧洲乘用车应用中的覆盖率达到 99.9%，帮助商店减少需要库存的替换传感器数量。

paras.en: But replacement isn’t always the answer. Autel TPMS tools also identify the appropriate stationary, automatic or OBD relearn procedures available for a vehicle, with on-screen instructions to guide technicians through the process.
paras.zh: 但更换并不总是答案。 Autel TPMS 工具还可以识别适用于车辆的适当固定、自动或 OBD 重新学习程序，并通过屏幕说明指导技术人员完成该过程。

paras.en: The episode also covers an often-overlooked final step: verifying the repair. Once the replacement or relearn is complete, technicians activate the sensors again to confirm they’re communicating properly before returning the vehicle to the customer.
paras.zh: 本集还介绍了经常被忽视的最后一步：验证修复。更换或重新学习完成后，技术人员会再次激活传感器，以确认它们能够正常通信，然后再将车辆返还给客户。

articles.title: The Walking Beam Suspension’s Performance at 100
articles.author: Tomorrow's Technician Staff

paras.en: Some mechanical ideas remain relevant because the problem they solve never disappears. Vocational trucks still encounter uneven ground, shifting loads, and conditions that can force one axle higher or lower than the other. Whether the vehicle is collecting refuse, delivering concrete, hauling material from a jobsite, or working in a mine, it must maintain traction and distribute weight without placing excessive stress on a single axle.
paras.zh: 一些机械思想仍然具有相关性，因为它们解决的问题永远不会消失。职业卡车仍然会遇到不平坦的地面、转移的负载以及迫使一个车轴高于或低于另一个车轴的情况。无论车辆是在收集垃圾、运送混凝土、从工地运输材料还是在矿山中作业，它都必须保持牵引力并分配重量，而不会对单个车轴施加过大的压力。

paras.en: The walking beam suspension was developed around this challenge. In 2026, Hendrickson marks the 100th anniversary of its patented walking beam design, a milestone that underscores how enduring that equalizing beam concept has been in heavy‑duty trucking. The equalizing beam connects two driven axles through a central pivot, allowing the suspension to move across uneven terrain while sharing the load between them. When one wheel rises over an obstacle, the beam transfers part of that movement to the other axle rather than allowing one axle to carry a disproportionate amount of weight, equalizing the load carried by the axles on each end of the walking beam.
paras.zh: 步进梁悬架就是围绕这一挑战而开发的。 2026 年，瀚瑞森将迎来其获得专利的步进梁设计 100 周年，这一里程碑凸显了均衡梁概念在重型卡车运输中的持久性。平衡梁通过中心枢轴连接两个驱动轴，使悬架能够在不平坦的地形上移动，同时分担它们之间的负载。当一个车轮升过障碍物时，横梁将部分运动转移到另一轴，而不是让一个轴承载不成比例的重量，从而平衡了步进梁两端的轴承载的负载。

paras.en: Hendrickson patented its original walking beam concept in 1926, laying the groundwork for a suspension architecture that has now been in continuous use for a century. At the time, roads outside major cities were often rough, rutted and poorly developed, so the design helped vehicles travel across those surfaces while reducing the concentrated loads that could otherwise cause damage to tires, rims, drive axles, suspension components, and the road itself.
paras.zh: 亨瑞森于 1926 年为其最初的步进梁概念申请了专利，为悬架架构奠定了基础，该架构现已连续使用一个世纪。当时，主要城市以外的道路往往崎岖不平、车辙多且发育不良，因此该设计有助于车辆在这些路面上行驶，同时减少集中载荷，否则可能会对轮胎、轮辋、驱动轴、悬架部件和道路本身造成损坏。

paras.en: A century later, the equalization principle behind the walking beam remains central to many heavy-duty suspensions. Nearly everything surrounding it, however, has advanced.
paras.zh: 一个世纪后，步进梁背后的均衡原理仍然是许多重型悬架的核心。然而，它周围的一切几乎都在进步。

paras.en: Building a Modern Suspension Around a Proven Principle
paras.zh: 围绕经过验证的原理构建现代悬架

paras.en: Early walking beam suspensions were designed for a largely utilitarian vehicle market. Their priority was carrying heavy loads through demanding conditions, even when the resulting ride was harsh. Early steel leaf spring components offered the strength required for heavy vocational work, but their stiffness could produce a rough ride when the truck was lightly loaded or empty. With less weight compressing the springs, road impacts and vibrations were transferred more directly into the cab, body and mounted equipment.
paras.zh: 早期的步进梁悬架是为主要实用的车辆市场而设计的。他们的首要任务是在苛刻的条件下承载重物，即使最终的行驶过程很恶劣。早期的钢板弹簧组件提供了重型职业工作所需的强度，但当卡车轻载或空载时，它们的刚度可能会导致行驶不平稳。由于压缩弹簧的重量更轻，道路冲击和振动可以更直接地传递到驾驶室、车身和安装的设备中。

paras.en: Modern vocational vehicles place broader demands on the suspension. Fleets require stability and off-road mobility, yet they also must consider driver comfort, vehicle weight, and the growing amount of sensitive equipment mounted on the truck. Hydraulic systems, electronic controls, and body components can all experience accelerated wear when subjected to continuous vibration. Minimizing those impacts and vibrations helps extend the auxiliary equipment life.
paras.zh: 现代职业车辆对悬架提出了更广泛的要求。车队需要稳定性和越野机动性，但他们还必须考虑驾驶员舒适度、车辆重量以及卡车上安装的越来越多的敏感设备。当受到持续振动时，液压系统、电子控制装置和车身部件都会加速磨损。最大限度地减少这些影响和振动有助于延长辅助设备的使用寿命。

paras.en: Advances in material and manufacturing processes have helped suspension designers and engineers address this need. Earlier designs relied heavily on cast steel and ductile iron, while newer generations make greater use of fabricated structures and higher strength steels. Utilizing fabrications also give manufacturers more flexibility to accommodate different beam lengths, capacities, and vehicle configurations without creating dedicated tooling for every variatio
paras.zh: 材料和制造工艺的进步帮助悬架设计师和工程师满足了这一需求。早期的设计严重依赖铸钢和球墨铸铁，而新一代设计则更多地使用装配式结构和更高强度的钢材。利用制造还为制造商提供了更大的灵活性，以适应不同的梁长度、容量和车辆配置，而无需为每种变化创建专用工具

paras.en: Spring technology has advanced alongside the walking beam, giving suspension engineers more flexibility to shape how the system behaves on the road. Modern rubber load springs help screen out road inputs that would otherwise reach the cab, body and mounted equipment, while progressive spring designs can be tuned to feel compliant in day‑to‑day service and provide firmer support when the vehicle is heavily loaded or operating off‑highway. As a result, contemporary suspensions can deliver a smoother, more controlled ride without compromising the stability demanded in heavy‑duty environments.
paras.zh: 弹簧技术与步进梁一起进步，为悬架工程师提供了更大的灵活性来塑造系统在道路上的表现。现代橡胶负载弹簧有助于屏蔽道路输入，否则这些输入将到达驾驶室、车身和安装设备，而渐进式弹簧设计可以进行调整，以适应日常使用，并在车辆重载或非公路行驶时提供更牢固的支撑。因此，现代悬架可以提供更平稳、更受控制的行驶，而不会影响重载环境所需的稳定性。

paras.en: Reducing suspension weight creates another practical advantage. Every pound removed from the chassis can contribute to additional payload, which has a direct operating value in weight sensitive applications. A refuse vehicle that can carry more material before returning to the landfill may complete its route with fewer trips. Concrete and aggregate fleets face similar calculations, making suspension weight part of a much larger productivity decision.
paras.zh: 减轻悬架重量带来了另一个实际优势。从底盘上减轻的每一磅都可以增加额外的有效负载，这在重量敏感的应用中具有直接的操作价值。在返回垃圾填埋场之前可以运载更多材料的垃圾车可能会以更少的行程完成其路线。混凝土和骨料车队面临类似的计算，使悬架重量成为更大的生产力决策的一部分。

paras.en: Walking beam-based suspensions are available in several configurations because vocational trucks operate under widely different conditions. The right design depends on factors such as load capacity, ride quality, terrain, available space beneath the chassis and the fleet’s maintenance priorities.
paras.zh: 由于职业卡车在不同的条件下运行，步进梁式悬架有多种配置。正确的设计取决于负载能力、行驶质量、地形、底盘下方的可用空间以及车队的维护优先级等因素。

paras.en: Spring design is one of the primary levers fleets and OEMs use to tailor these suspensions to specific vocational roles. Traditional steel spring systems are typically specified where operators value long‑term durability, familiar service procedures and straightforward field repairs, including remote or harsh operating locations. Rubber spring systems become attractive when reducing suspension weight and further limiting vibration into the chassis take priority, particularly for vehicles that spend significant time traveling empty or with partial loads. Progressive spring configurations are then applied in heavy‑duty applications that must carry heavier payloads or work off‑road, providing additional support as operating demands increase so fleets can preserve the stability they need while maintaining ride quality.
paras.zh: 弹簧设计是车队和原始设备制造商用来根据特定职业角色定制这些悬架的主要杠杆之一。传统钢弹簧系统通常指定用于操作员重视长期耐用性、熟悉的维修程序和简单的现场维修的地方，包括偏远或恶劣的操作地点。当优先考虑减轻悬架重量并进一步限制底盘振动时，橡胶弹簧系统变得有吸引力，特别是对于花费大量时间空载或部分负载行驶的车辆而言。然后，渐进式弹簧配置应用于必须承载较重有效载荷或越野工作的重型应用，随着操作需求的增加提供额外的支持，以便车队可以在保持行驶质量的同时保持所需的稳定性。

paras.en: Articulation also affects how well the suspension performs on uneven ground. As the axles articulate through different positions, the suspension must allow enough wheel travel to help the tires maintain contact with the surface. Maintaining that contact supports traction and reduces the likelihood that one axle will carry an excessive share of the load. Depending on the suspension, diagonal articulation may range from approximately 15 inches to more than 17 inches.
paras.zh: 铰接也会影响悬架在不平坦地面上的表现。当车轴通过不同位置进行铰接时，悬架必须允许足够的车轮行程，以帮助轮胎保持与地面的接触。保持这种接触可以支持牵引力，并降低一根车轴承载过多负载的可能性。根据悬架的不同，对角铰接范围可能从大约 15 英寸到超过 17 英寸。

paras.en: Torque rods provide another layer of control. Longitudinal torque rods help the axles resist the forces created during braking and acceleration, while transverse rods limit side-to-side movement and support lateral stability. On a loaded refuse truck making an emergency stop, the longitudinal rods help keep the axles properly positioned as the body’s weight shifts forward. When that same vehicle crosses uneven ground at a disposal site, the transverse rods control lateral movement of the axles as one side rises above the other.
paras.zh: 扭力杆提供另一层控制。纵向扭矩杆帮助车轴抵抗制动和加速过程中产生的力，而横向杆则限制左右移动并支持横向稳定性。在满载垃圾车紧急停车时，纵向杆有助于在车身重量向前移动时保持车轴正确定位。当同一车辆在处理地点穿过不平坦的地面时，横向杆控制车轴的横向运动，因为一侧高于另一侧。

paras.en: A carefully planned vehicle specification helps bushings, springs, mounting hardware and other suspension components operate efficiently within their intended design limits, reducing strain that could otherwise shorten component life. These relationships explain why fleets need to work with their truck dealer and OEM, to help to specify the most appropriate suspension for their application rather than choosing a configuration, spring type or capacity rating in isolation.
paras.zh: 精心规划的车辆规格有助于衬套、弹簧、安装硬件和其他悬架部件在其预期设计限制内有效运行，从而减少可能缩短部件寿命的应变。这些关系解释了为什么车队需要与卡车经销商和 OEM 合作，帮助指定最适合其应用的悬架，而不是单独选择配置、弹簧类型或额定容量。

paras.en: Hendrickson, a privately held commercial vehicle industry supplier known for suspension and integrated ride systems for heavy duty trucks, trailers and specialty vehicles, traces its walking beam technology to its original suspension design developed by company founder Magnus Hendrickson in 1926. The company has continued to refine that foundational equalizing beam concept across several modern configurations. Its RT suspension remains the closest to the original architecture. The steel spring system is familiar to generations of operators and technicians, while its straightforward construction and broad parts availability continue to serve fleets that value field repairability. The configuration can also suit vehicles with packaging constraints, such as vacuum trucks that need space beneath the chassis for large piping.
paras.zh: Hendrickson 是一家私营商用车行业供应商，以重型卡车、拖车和特种车辆的悬架和集成行驶系统而闻名，其步进梁技术可追溯到公司创始人 Magnus Hendrickson 于 1926 年开发的原始悬架设计。该公司不断在多种现代配置中完善基本均衡梁概念。它的 RT 悬架仍然最接近原始架构。钢弹簧系统为几代操作员和技术人员所熟悉，而其简单的结构和广泛的零件可用性继续为重视现场可修复性的车队提供服务。该配置还适合具有包装限制的车辆，例如需要底盘下方空间用于大型管道的真空卡车。

paras.en: Among Hendrickson’s other walking beam-based suspension systems, HAULMAAX EX uses rubber spring technology to reduce weight and improve ride quality while maintaining stability for on- and off-highway applications such as refuse trucks, concrete mixers and dump vehicles. The ULTIMAAX suspension is designed for higher capacity, predominantly off highway work, including mining and oil field applications where heavier loads and greater articulation require additional support.
paras.zh: 在瀚瑞森的其他步进梁式悬架系统中，HAULMAAX EX 采用橡胶弹簧技术来减轻重量并提高乘坐质量，同时保持垃圾车、混凝土搅拌机和自卸车等公路和非公路应用的稳定性。 ULTIMAAX 悬架设计用于更高的承载能力，主要是非公路作业，包括采矿和油田应用，其中较重的负载和更大的铰接需要额外的支撑。

paras.en: Validating Heavy‑Duty Performance Before Production
paras.zh: 生产前验证重型性能

paras.en: Hendrickson’s walking beam suspensions are closely associated with durability, but that reputation depends on how thoroughly each design is validated before it reaches a production vehicle. Modern validation focuses on shortening development time, improving confidence for OEMs and fleets, and ensuring that heavy-duty products behave predictably in the field.
paras.zh: 瀚瑞森的步进梁式悬架与耐用性密切相关，但这种声誉取决于每个设计在投入量产车辆之前验证的彻底程度。现代验证的重点是缩短开发时间、提高原始设备制造商和车队的信心，并确保重型产品在现场的表现可预测。

paras.en: Heavy-duty validation begins with understanding how the vehicle is actually used. Laboratory assumptions alone cannot fully represent a logging road in Canada, an oil field in Texas, or a mine where vehicles may regularly encounter overload, corrosion, and extreme articulation.
paras.zh: 重型验证首先要了解车辆的实际使用情况。仅凭实验室假设并不能完全代表加拿大的伐木道路、德克萨斯州的油田或车辆可能经常遇到过载、腐蚀和极端铰接的矿井。

paras.en: A thorough validation program therefore starts in the field. Sensors and measurement equipment are installed on vehicles to record the forces entering the suspension during actual operation. Engineers then use that data to define the loads, movements, and durability cycles that the full suspension and the individual components must withstand, creating a test plan grounded in the application rather than a generalized idea of heavy-duty service.
paras.zh: 因此，全面的验证计划从现场开始。车辆上安装了传感器和测量设备，用于记录实际运行过程中进入悬架的力。然后，工程师使用这些数据来定义整个悬架和各个部件必须承受的负载、运动和耐久性周期，从而创建基于应用的测试计划，而不是重型服务的一般概念。

paras.en: Those real-world measurements are then reproduced in a laboratory, where repeated loading, articulation and shock are applied under controlled conditions. Data gathered in demanding operating environments is brought into Hendrickson Truck Commercial Vehicle Systems’ test laboratory in Woodridge, IL, where a dedicated tandem test rig can apply those same forces to a complete tandem suspension. By condensing months of proving ground and fleet operation into a controlled test campaign lasting several weeks, engineers can observe how components behave under accelerated life conditions and confirm that they meet or exceed the criteria defined in the design validation plan.
paras.zh: 然后在实验室中重现这些真实世界的测量结果，在受控条件下重复加载、铰接和冲击。在严苛的操作环境中收集的数据被输入位于伊利诺伊州伍德里奇的亨瑞森卡车商用车系统测试实验室，在那里，专用的串联测试台可以将相同的力施加到完整的串联悬架上。通过将数月的试验场和车队运行浓缩为持续数周的受控测试活动，工程师可以观察组件在加速寿命条件下的表现，并确认它们满足或超过设计验证计划中定义的标准。

paras.en: This approach also affects how quickly new suspensions reach the market. When OEMs understand how the laboratory test plan reflects real-world forces and see consistent correlation with field performance, they can place greater confidence in the lab results. In many cases, that trust reduces or eliminates the need for long, redundant fleet trials before a new suspension can be released, helping OEMs and fleets adopt updated designs sooner.
paras.zh: 这种方法还会影响新悬架进入市场的速度。当原始设备制造商了解实验室测试计划如何反映现实世界的力量并看到与现场性能的一致相关性时，他们可以对实验室结果更有信心。在许多情况下，这种信任减少或消除了在发布新悬架之前进行长时间、冗余的车队试验的需要，从而帮助原始设备制造商和车队更快地采用更新的设计。

paras.en: Validation also must reflect differences among markets. Vehicle configurations, regulations, road quality and loading practices vary by country and even by state. In some regions, potential vehicle overload conditions shape the design criteria; elsewhere, salt exposure, rough terrain or packaging constraints may create the dominant concern. Developing an effective suspension therefore requires local field research rather than assuming that a successful North American specification will transfer unchanged to another market.
paras.zh: 验证还必须反映市场之间的差异。车辆配置、法规、道路质量和装载实践因国家/地区甚至州而异。在一些地区，潜在的车辆超载条件决定了设计标准；在其他地方，盐暴露、崎岖的地形或包装限制可能会引起主要关注。因此，开发有效的悬架需要进行本地实地研究，而不是假设成功的北美规范将不变地转移到另一个市场。

paras.en: That application work continues after the vehicle enters service. Hendrickson’s sales, service and engineering teams regularly visit fleets, review installations and troubleshoot vehicles in the field when operating conditions reveal an unexpected challenge. Details such as torque rod length, clocking angles of bushings, axle alignment and component clearance can have a cumulative effect on ride and component life, so installation and layout development become part of the suspension’s long-term performance rather than an afterthought.
paras.zh: 该应用程序工作在车辆投入使用后继续进行。当操作条件出现意外挑战时，瀚瑞森的销售、服务和工程团队定期访问车队、检查安装并在现场对车辆进行故障排除。扭矩杆长度、衬套时钟角度、轴对准和部件间隙等细节会对行驶和部件寿命产生累积影响，因此安装和布局开发成为悬架长期性能的一部分，而不是事后才想到的。

paras.en: For fleets, that means the suspension is supported through both “push” efforts, where Hendrickson works closely with OEM engineering teams, and “pull” efforts, where field sales and service staff provide training, troubleshooting and specification guidance directly to fleet operators.
paras.zh: 对于车队来说，这意味着悬挂是通过“推动”工作（瀚瑞森与 OEM 工程团队密切合作）和“拉动”努力（现场销售和服务人员直接向车队运营商提供培训、故障排除和规范指导）来支持的。

paras.en: The walking beam suspension has endured because load equalization remains valuable wherever trucks must carry significant weight across uneven terrain. Its future will depend on continuing to refine the complete suspension around that principle.
paras.zh: 步进梁式悬架之所以能经久不衰，是因为在卡车必须在不平坦的地形上承载大量重量的地方，负载均衡仍然很有价值。它的未来将取决于围绕这一原则继续完善整个悬架。

paras.en: Weight reduction and maintenance will remain major priorities as vocational vehicles become more expensive, and fleets focus more closely on total cost of ownership. Electric drive axles will introduce new packaging and interface requirements, while sensing technology may give operators a clearer understanding of vehicle weight and loading conditions.
paras.zh: 随着职业车辆变得更加昂贵，并且车队更加关注总体拥有成本，减重和维护仍将是主要优先事项。电动驱动桥将引入新的封装和接口要求，而传感技术可以让操作员更清楚地了解车辆重量和负载条件。

paras.en: Suspension components will also need to work closer with braking, wheel end, tire inflation and vehicle control technologies, creating complete ride systems that manage load, vibration and traction as an integrated whole rather than a collection of independent parts.
paras.zh: 悬架组件还需要与制动、轮端、轮胎充气和车辆控制技术紧密配合，创建完整的行驶系统，将负载、振动和牵引力作为一个整体而不是独立部件的集合来管理。

paras.en: After 100 years, the walking beam suspension no longer represents a single fixed design. It serves as an engineering foundation that continues to be adapted to new materials, powertrain options and operating demands. Vocational trucks can be powered by diesel, natural gas, or electricity, and can even be equipped with the most advanced sensing systems. For fleets, the enduring value lies in specifying a suspension that reflects the work the vehicle will perform, verifying that every component around the suspension is designed, validated and supported to perform dependably over the long term.
paras.zh: 100 年后，步进梁悬架不再代表单一的固定设计。它作为工程基础，不断适应新材料、动力总成选项和操作需求。职业卡车可以采用柴油、天然气或电力作为动力，甚至可以配备最先进的传感系统。对于车队来说，持久的价值在于指定一个反映车辆将执行的工作的悬架，验证悬架周围的每个组件都经过设计、验证和支持，以便长期可靠地运行。

paras.en: This article was contributed by Gerry Remus, Vice President & General Manager, Hendrickson Truck Commercial Vehicle Systems, and Mark Williamson, Manager, Product Marketing & Tech Services, Hendrickson Truck Commercial Vehicle Systems
paras.zh: 本文由亨瑞森卡车商用车系统副总裁兼总经理 Gerry Remus 和亨瑞森卡车商用车系统产品营销与技术服务经理 Mark Williamson 撰写

articles.title: Volkswagen 1.4L TSI Maintenance and Inspection Tips
articles.author: Tomorrow's Technician Staff

paras.en: The Volkswagen 1.4L TSI turbocharged EA211 engine has been around for about a decade now, and it was standard equipment on several Volkswagen models here in the U.S., including the MK7 Golf and the Jetta Hybrid. This compact but powerful engine replaced the naturally aspirated 2.5L five-cylinder engine. It makes a respectable 140 hp, but it makes a stout 184 lb.-ft. at an astonishingly low peak of 1,400 rpm. That means that peak torque is available practically from idle, making this engine the perfect powerplant for the typical “daily driver.”
paras.zh: 大众 1.4L TSI 涡轮增压 EA211 发动机已经问世了大约十年，它是美国多款大众车型的标准配备，包括 MK7 高尔夫和捷达混合动力车。这款紧凑但功能强大的发动机取代了自然吸气 2.5L 五缸发动机。它的功率为 140 马力，但重量为 184 磅英尺。峰值转速极低，为 1,400 rpm。这意味着实际上可以在怠速时获得峰值扭矩，使该发动机成为典型“日常驾驶员”的完美动力装置。

paras.en: The Volkswagen 1.4L TSI focuses on fuel economy above all, and it is exceedingly good at it. It’s lighter than other 4-cylinder VW engines, thanks to its all-aluminum block construction, which sheds around 42 pounds. Thanks to lighter connecting rods and crankshaft counterweights, the engine is 49 pounds lighter overall and as much as 20% more fuel efficient, according to VW.
paras.zh: 大众1.4L TSI首先注重燃油经济性，并且在这方面做得非常出色。由于采用全铝缸体结构，它比其他 4 缸大众发动机更轻，重量减轻了约 42 磅。据大众汽车称，得益于更轻的连杆和曲轴配重，该发动机整体重量减轻了 49 磅，燃油效率提高了 20%。

paras.en: Another notable innovation on this engine is the fact that the exhaust manifold is incorporated into the cylinder head (Figure 1). This reduces the distance between the exhaust valves and the turbocharger, saves weight and helps to heat up the catalytic converter faster, reducing tailpipe emissions.
paras.zh: 该发动机的另一个值得注意的创新是将排气歧管集成到气缸盖中（图 1）。这缩短了排气门和涡轮增压器之间的距离，减轻了重量，并有助于更快地加热催化转化器，从而减少尾气排放。

paras.en: The manifold is surrounded by coolant jackets that help the engine to reach operating temperature faster and provide warm air inside the cabin quicker than ever before. This coolant circuit is isolated from the rest of the system, but we’ll talk more about that later.
paras.zh: 歧管周围有冷却套，可帮助发动机更快地达到工作温度，并比以往更快地在机舱内提供暖空气。该冷却剂回路与系统的其余部分隔离，但我们稍后会详细讨论。

paras.en: Technical Service Bulletins can be very valuable for techs and vehicle owners who may notice a particular symptom on a vehicle. They also can be used to identify a pattern failure, or a common symptom that is seen by many vehicle owners over time. However, there are very few TSBs which apply specifically to the EA211. Let’s take a look at some unique features of this engine family, as well as a few issues that you may come across.
paras.zh: 技术服务公告对于可能注意到车辆上的特定症状的技术人员和车主来说非常有价值。它们还可以用于识别模式故障，或者许多车主随着时间的推移看到的常见症状。然而，专门适用于 EA211 的 TSB 很少。让我们看一下该发动机系列的一些独特功能，以及您可能遇到的一些问题。

paras.en: Yes, you read that right, VW has gone back to timing belts on this engine (Figure 2). Now I know what you may be thinking; this is not the same belt that we saw installed on the older 1.8T engine in the MK4 GTI. The belt drive means less friction loss compared to a chain drive, and VW says that it’s good for the lifetime of the engine. It’s true, you won’t find “replace timing belt” called out anywhere on the maintenance chart. This may make some of us just as nervous, like when other manufacturers started calling their transmission or differential oil “lifetime oil,” but we’re hoping that VW has done the work and these belt drives will last a long time.
paras.zh: 是的，您没有看错，大众汽车已经在这款发动机上重新使用正时皮带（图 2）。现在我知道你可能在想什么；这与我们在 MK4 GTI 的旧 1.8T 发动机上看到的安装的皮带不同。与链条传动相比，皮带传动意味着摩擦损失更小，大众表示这有利于发动机的使用寿命。确实，您不会在维护图表上的任何地方找到“更换正时皮带”的字样。这可能会让我们中的一些人同样紧张，就像其他制造商开始将他们的变速箱油或差速器油称为“终身油”一样，但我们希望大众已经完成了这项工作，并且这些皮带传动装置将持续很长时间。

paras.en: So, what could shorten the service life of a timing belt? Aggressive tuning, which raises the rev-limiter, or oil or coolant intrusion inside the timing cover from a leaking gasket or hose, immediately come to mind. It would be wise to include a visual inspection of the timing belt around the 100,000-mile mark to help keep the engine running for years to come.
paras.zh: 那么，哪些因素会缩短同步带的使用寿命呢？立即浮现在脑海中的是激进的调整，即提高转速限制器，或者油或冷却剂因泄漏的垫圈或软管而侵入正时盖内部。明智的做法是在 100,000 英里标记周围对正时皮带进行目视检查，以帮助发动机在未来几年保持运行。

paras.en: Say goodbye to the air-to-air intercooler and hello to the new air-to-water heat exchanger. This new intercooler is integrated directly into the intake manifold, making the engine even more compact. It also has the added benefit of reducing the distance the charge air needs to travel from the turbocharger to the cylinders.
paras.zh: 告别空对空中冷器，迎接新型空对水热交换器。这种新型中冷器直接集成到进气歧管中，使发动机更加紧凑。它还具有减少增压空气从涡轮增压器到气缸所需的距离的额外好处。

paras.en: Oil changes are easier on the EA211 compared to the 1.8L or 2.0L EA888. No special tools are required for this job, thanks to the traditional spin-on oil filter on the front of the engine and the steel drain plug (not plastic like the EA888).
paras.zh: 与 1.8L 或 2.0L EA888 相比，EA211 的机油更换更容易。得益于发动机前部的传统旋装式机油滤清器和钢制放油塞（不是像 EA888 那样的塑料塞），这项工作不需要特殊工具。

paras.en: Potential Coolant Leak #1: Thermostat & Water Pump Assembly
paras.zh: 潜在的冷却液泄漏#1：恒温器和水泵组件

paras.en: The water pump on this engine is driven by a small-toothed belt on the back side of the exhaust camshaft (Figure 3). This belt is located behind a plastic cover, over the transmission case on the cylinder head. There is a large thermostat assembly that is bolted to the outside of the water pump. This thermostat assembly houses two different thermostats; one to manage coolant flow for the engine block and another to manage coolant flow for the cylinder head (Figure 4).
paras.zh: 该发动机上的水泵由排气凸轮轴背面的小齿皮带驱动（图 3）。该皮带位于塑料盖后面，气缸盖上的变速箱上方。有一个大型恒温器组件用螺栓固定在水泵的外部。该恒温器组件装有两个不同的恒温器；一个用于管理发动机缸体的冷却剂流量，另一个用于管理气缸盖的冷却剂流量（图 4）。

paras.en: These plastic thermostat assemblies have been known to fail or leak prematurely if they come into contact with engine oil, sometimes from a leaking PCV assembly. It’s important to watch for any signs of coolant leaking in the area of the thermostat assembly and advise your customer accordingly.
paras.zh: 众所周知，这些塑料恒温器组件如果与发动机油接触，有时会因 PCV 组件泄漏而过早失效或泄漏。重要的是要注意恒温器组件区域是否存在冷却剂泄漏的迹象，并相应地向客户提供建议。

paras.en: The water pump drive belt could also fail due to oil contamination. This would result in a complete loss of coolant flow, and the engine would overheat quickly.
paras.zh: 水泵传动皮带也可能因油污染而发生故障。这将导致冷却剂流量完全丧失，发动机会迅速过热。

paras.en: The coolant pipe, which runs underneath the air box, may be damaged and leak. This is caused by the pipe rubbing up against the bottom of the air box (Figure 5).
paras.zh: 位于空气箱下方的冷却液管可能会损坏并泄漏。这是由于管道与空气箱底部摩擦造成的（图 5）。

paras.en: Replace the coolant pipe with the updated pipe assembly (part number 04E 121 064 S), which features an insulation wrap for protection (Figure 6).
paras.zh: 使用更新的管道组件（零件号 04E 121 064 S）更换冷却剂管道，该管道组件具有绝缘包裹以提供保护（图 6）。

articles.title: Don’t Forget Lubrication During an Oil Change
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: Back in my day at the service station, when a customer came in for an oil change, they pulled it into a grease pit and we would grease up everything on the vehicle—ball joints, universal joints, and then we would do the oil changes. Today, it’s different. Vehicles are a lot more low maintenance.
paras.zh: 回到我在服务站的日子，当客户来换油时，他们把它拉进油坑，我们会给车辆上的所有东西涂上油脂——球节、万向节，然后我们会换油。今天，情况有所不同。车辆的维护费用要低得多。

paras.en: However, the aftermarket has not abandoned the message that lubrication is required for certain repair components to make that repair just that much better. In other words, we have ball joints that have grease nipples that need to be lubricated every so often, like during an oil change. It’s also written in the vehicle service information that doors and lift hatches need to be lubricated every so often.
paras.zh: 然而，售后市场并没有放弃这样的信息：某些维修部件需要润滑才能使维修效果更好。换句话说，我们的球窝接头带有油嘴，需要经常润滑，例如在换油期间。车辆服务信息中还写明，车门和电梯舱口需要经常润滑。

paras.en: Your shop probably has an oil change and you probably call it an LOF. So let’s put that L back in LOF: lubrication, oil, filter.
paras.zh: 您的商店可能需要更换机油，您可能称其为 LOF。所以让我们把 L 放回 LOF：润滑、机油、过滤器。

paras.zh: 该视频由 Auto Value 和 Bumper To Bumper 赞助。

articles.title: Bringing ADAS Calibration In-House
articles.author: ImportCar Staff Writers

paras.en: See how Vann York Collision Center in High Point, North Carolina, is using Autel technology to bring ADAS calibration in-house, streamline collision repair workflows, and reduce reliance on outsourced services.
paras.zh: 了解位于北卡罗来纳州海波因特的 Vann York 碰撞中心如何使用 Autel 技术将 ADAS 校准引入内部、简化碰撞修复工作流程并减少对外包服务的依赖。

paras.en: ASE-Certified Master Automobile Technician Eric visits Vann York to talk with the team about their transition to Autel diagnostic, ADAS calibration and wheel alignment equipment. After working with other scan and calibration tools, the team shares how Autel has helped simplify setup, improve usability and bring alignment and ADAS calibration together in a more efficient workflow.
paras.zh: ASE 认证汽车技术大师 Eric 拜访 Vann York，与团队讨论他们向 Autel 诊断、ADAS 校准和车轮定位设备的过渡。在与其他扫描和校准工具合作后，该团队分享了 Autel 如何帮助简化设置、提高可用性以及在更高效的工作流程中将对准和 ADAS 校准结合在一起。

paras.en: With guided software, integrated alignment and calibration capabilities, training and technical support, Vann York is building more control into the repair process—and planning to expand its use of Autel equipment as the business grows.
paras.zh: 凭借引导软件、集成对准和校准功能、培训和技术支持，Vann York 正在对维修过程进行更多控制，并计划随着业务的增长扩大 Autel 设备的使用。

articles.title: Niterra President and CEO Mike Schwab on ‘Delivering Trusted Solutions’
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Mike Schwab, president and CEO of Niterra North America, Inc.
paras.zh: 本期 DriveTime 的主角是 Niterra North America, Inc. 的总裁兼首席执行官 Mike Schwab。

paras.en: Schwab said Niterra has evolved well beyond its roots as an ignition specialist while maintaining the quality and reliability associated with its NGK brand. Today, Niterra’s automotive portfolio extends beyond spark plugs to include ignition coils, wire sets, NTK oxygen and technical sensors and rotating electrical products such as starters and alternators.
paras.zh: Schwab 表示，Niterra 已经远远超越了其作为点火专家的根源，同时保持了 NGK 品牌相关的质量和可靠性。如今，Niterra 的汽车产品组合已不仅仅局限于火花塞，还包括点火线圈、电线组、NTK 氧气和技术传感器以及起动机和交流发电机等旋转电气产品。

paras.en: Schwab emphasized that quality, integrity, teamwork and consistent execution remain fundamental to Niterra’s business strategy, even as the industry evolves. These principles, he says, guide how the company serves customers, from delivering dependable products and maintaining transparency to strengthening partnerships and addressing customer challenges. Schwab emphasized that execution means consistently delivering on commitments involving product availability, customer service and new product introductions. While technology and product offerings will continue to change, he believes trust, reliability and strong customer relationships will remain essential to the company’s long-term success.
paras.zh: Schwab 强调，即使行业不断发展，质量、诚信、团队合作和一致执行仍然是 Niterra 业务战略的基础。他说，这些原则指导公司如何服务客户，从提供可靠的产品和保持透明度到加强合作伙伴关系和应对客户挑战。施瓦布强调，执行意味着始终如一地兑现涉及产品可用性、客户服务和新产品推出的承诺。尽管技术和产品供应将不断变化，但他相信信任、可靠性和强大的客户关系对于公司的长期成功仍然至关重要。

paras.en: Looking ahead, Schwab said the transition from NGK Spark Plug to Niterra represents a broader transformation rather than simply a name change. While continuing to strengthen its automotive business, the company is pursuing growth in new products, technologies and markets that build on its engineering capabilities. Opportunities in advanced mobility, electric vehicles and other emerging technologies are part of that strategy. Schwab said the Niterra name, derived from Latin words meaning “to shine” and “Earth,” reflects the company’s ambition to contribute to a more sustainable future.
paras.zh: 展望未来，Schwab 表示，从 NGK Spark Plug 到 Niterra 的转变代表着更广泛的转变，而不仅仅是名称更改。在继续加强汽车业务的同时，该公司正在以其工程能力为基础，寻求新产品、技术和市场的增长。先进移动、电动汽车和其他新兴技术的机会是该战略的一部分。施瓦布表示，Niterra 这个名字源自拉丁语，意思是“闪耀”和“地球”，反映了该公司为更加可持续的未来做出贡献的雄心。

paras.en: To hear more of Schwab’s insights, be sure to watch the above video.
paras.zh: 要了解更多施瓦布的见解，请务必观看上面的视频。

paras.en: - How Niterra is expanding beyond spark plugs with a broader portfolio of ignition, sensor and rotating electrical products. (4:49)
paras.zh: - Niterra 如何超越火花塞，推出更广泛的点火、传感器和旋转电气产品组合。 （4:49）

paras.en: - Quality, integrity, teamwork and execution remain fundamental to Niterra’s business strategy and help strengthen customer relationships and deliver value. (6:17)
paras.zh: - 质量、诚信、团队合作和执行仍然是 Niterra 业务战略的基础，有助于加强客户关系并创造价值。 （6:17）

paras.en: - Niterra emphasizes a people-first approach to serving the industry and what that commitment looks like in practice for customers, employees and partners. (9:14)
paras.zh: - Niterra 强调以人为本的方法来服务行业，以及这种承诺在实践中对客户、员工和合作伙伴的影响。 （9:14）

paras.en: - How the Niterra name reflects the company’s evolution and future growth opportunities in advanced mobility and new technologies. (11:06)
paras.zh: - Niterra 名称如何反映公司在先进移动性和新技术方面的发展和未来增长机会。 (11:06)

paras.en: - The story behind Niterra’s name and the employee-driven process that helped create it. (13:23)
paras.zh: - Niterra 名称背后的故事以及帮助创建它的员工驱动流程。 (13:23)

paras.en: - Lightning Round: Schwab shares some personal insights. (14:59)
paras.zh: - 闪电轮：施瓦布分享了一些个人见解。 (14:59)

articles.title: MEYLE German License Plate Fundraiser to Return to AAPEX
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: MEYLE announced that it will bring its German license plate fundraiser to raise money for Northwood University scholarships back to AAPEX 2026 (Nov. 3-5 in Las Vegas).
paras.zh: MEYLE 宣布将在 AAPEX 2026（11 月 3 日至 5 日在拉斯维加斯）举行德国车牌筹款活动，为诺斯伍德大学奖学金筹集资金。

paras.en: MEYLE will host the fundraiser at its exhibit at the show, featuring a German license plate stamping machine. Visitors can create custom MEYLE-branded plates in exchange for donations benefiting Northwood students.
paras.zh: MEYLE 将在展会上的展位上举办筹款活动，展出一台德国车牌冲压机。参观者可以制作定制的 MEYLE 品牌盘子，以换取惠及诺斯伍德学生的捐款。

paras.en: Last year’s initiative generated $9,171 in donations. MEYLE supplemented that amount with a $5,000 matching contribution, bringing the total to $14,171.
paras.zh: 去年的倡议筹集了 9,171 美元的捐款。 MEYLE 补充了 5,000 美元的配套捐款，使总额达到 14,171 美元。

paras.en: Northwood Student Receives First MEYLE Scholarship
paras.zh: 诺斯伍德学生获得首届梅尔奖学金

paras.en: Earlier this year, Quinn Balcam became the first recipient of the MEYLE scholarship. Balcam, an automotive aftermarket management major from Bloomington, Indiana, serves as president of Northwood’s student aftermarket club.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，Quinn Balcam 成为第一位获得 MEYLE 奖学金的人。巴尔卡姆是来自印第安纳州布卢明顿的汽车售后市场管理专业学生，担任诺斯伍德学生售后市场俱乐部的主席。

paras.en: MEYLE notes that Balcam has demonstrated his industry commitment through multiple internships and leadership in the Northwood University International Auto Show’s aftermarket division. He has also participated in events including AAPEX, SEMA and Heavy-Duty Aftermarket Week.
paras.zh: MEYLE 指出，Balcam 通过在诺斯伍德大学国际汽车展售后市场部门的多次实习和领导，展示了他的行业承诺。他还参加了 AAPEX、SEMA 和重型售后市场周等活动。

paras.en: “Seeing the funds raised at AAPEX translate into scholarship support for a student like Quinn illustrates why partnerships like this are so important,” said James O’Dell, director of aftermarket education at Northwood University. “The automotive aftermarket needs talented, motivated young professionals, and MEYLE is helping our students gain both the financial support and industry connections they need to succeed.”
paras.zh: 诺斯伍德大学售后教育总监詹姆斯·奥戴尔 (James O'Dell) 表示：“看到 AAPEX 筹集的资金转化为对 Quinn 这样的学生的奖学金支持，这说明了为什么这样的合作伙伴关系如此重要。” “汽车售后市场需要有才华、积极进取的年轻专业人士，MEYLE 正在帮助我们的学生获得成功所需的财务支持和行业联系。”
