articles.title: Length of rental slightly up in Q3, shop scheduling backlogs down
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Enterprise Mobility reports that overall Length of Rental (LOR) for collision-related rentals in Q3 2026 was 15.5 days, up 0.4 days from Q2 and 0.1 days from Q3 2025.
paras.zh: Enterprise Mobility 报告称，2026 年第三季度碰撞相关租赁的总体租赁时间 (LOR) 为 15.5 天，比第二季度增加 0.4 天，比 2025 年第三季度增加 0.1 天。

paras.en: “This modest rise is notable when comparing Q3 2025’s results to Q3 2024, when overall LOR declined 0.9 days; Q3 2026’s results are the first Q3-over-Q3 increase since 2022,” the report states.
paras.zh: 报告指出：“将 2025 年第三季度的结果与 2024 年第三季度的结果进行比较时，这一小幅上升值得注意，当时总体 LOR 下降了 0.9 天；2026 年第三季度的结果是自 2022 年以来首次出现环比增长。”

paras.en: “Apart from the early months of the pandemic in 2020, that was the highest percentage of shops reporting such an open schedule in the nearly 10 years since the quarterly “Who Pays” surveys began asking about scheduling backlog,” Yoswick said in the LOR report.
paras.zh: Yoswick 在 LOR 报告中表示：“除了 2020 年疫情爆发的前几个月之外，这是自季度性‘谁付钱’季度调查开始询问排班积压情况以来近 10 年来，报告此类开放排班的商店比例最高的一次。”

paras.en: He added that work in progress (WIP) fell to another new low in Q3 2026, reaching 49% in September, according to CRASH Network’s “Collision Industry Business Perspectives” survey.
paras.zh: 他补充说，根据 CRASH Network 的“碰撞行业商业前景”调查，在制品 (WIP) 在 2026 年第三季度再创新低，9 月份达到 49%。

paras.en: Ryan Mandell, Mitchell International’s vice president of strategy and market intelligence, added that the percentage of parts repaired continued upward in Q3, reaching 17.8% from 16.4% in Q3 2025.
paras.zh: 米切尔国际公司战略和市场情报副总裁 Ryan Mandell 补充说，第三季度维修零件的百分比继续上升，从 2025 年第三季度的 16.4% 达到 17.8%。

paras.en: Q3 drivable LOR was 14.6 days, a 0.2-day increase from Q3 2025. Alaska and Rhode Island had the joint-highest LOR at 18.9 days each, followed by Massachusetts at 16.8 days.
paras.zh: 第三季度的可行驶 LOR 为 14.6 天，比 2025 年第三季度增加了 0.2 天。阿拉斯加和罗德岛州的 LOR 并列最高，均为 18.9 天，其次是马萨诸塞州，为 16.8 天。

paras.en: North Dakota had the lowest drivable LOR at 9.8 days, followed by Hawaii (11.2 days) and the District of Columbia (11.4 days).
paras.zh: 北达科他州的可驾驶 LOR 最低，为 9.8 天，其次是夏威夷（11.2 天）和哥伦比亚特区（11.4 天）。

paras.en: Iowa recorded the largest increase, with drivable LOR up 1.7 days year over year to 12.9 days. Georgia (15.6 days) had the largest decrease, down 0.9 days.
paras.zh: 爱荷华州的增幅最大，可行驶 LOR 天数同比增加 1.7 天，达到 12.9 天。格鲁吉亚（15.6 天）降幅最大，减少了 0.9 天。

paras.en: Greg Horn, Chief Industry Relations Officer at PartsTrader, said drivable LOR “aligns closely with parts delivery days.”
paras.zh: PartsTrader 首席行业关系官 Greg Horn 表示，可行驶的 LOR“与零件交付天数密切相关”。

paras.en: Non-drivable LOR didn’t change compared to Q3 2025, remaining at 21.2 days.
paras.zh: 与 2025 年第三季度相比，不可行驶的 LOR 没有变化，仍为 21.2 天。

paras.en: Alaska had the highest non-drivable LOR at 30 days, followed by West Virginia at 26.3 days and Wyoming at 24.4 days. West Virginia (21.2 days) recorded its largest decrease, down 3.1 days from Q3 2025.
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加的不可驾驶 LOR 最高，为 30 天，其次是西弗吉尼亚州，为 26.3 天，怀俄明州为 24.4 天。西弗吉尼亚州（21.2 天）降幅最大，比 2025 年第三季度减少了 3.1 天。

paras.en: Total loss claim LOR was 14.2 days, a 0.3-day increase above Q3 2025. West Virginia had the highest total loss LOR at 18.1 days, followed by New Hampshire at 17.4 days and Rhode Island at 17.2 days. South Dakota had the lowest total loss LOR at 11.3 days.
paras.zh: 总损失索赔 LOR 为 14.2 天，比 2025 年第三季度增加了 0.3 天。西弗吉尼亚州的总损失 LOR 最高，为 18.1 天，其次是新罕布什尔州，为 17.4 天，罗德岛州为 17.2 天。南达科他州的总损失 LOR 最低，为 11.3 天。

paras.en: “Total Loss frequency rose again to 21.0%, up from 20.3% in Q3 2025,” said Mandell in the report. “With more borderline vehicles ending up as write-offs, this contributes to some of the reduction in repairable claims volume the industry has been experiencing.”
paras.zh: 曼德尔在报告中表示：“总损失频率再次上升至 21.0%，高于 2025 年第三季度的 20.3%。” “随着越来越多的边缘车辆最终被报废，这导致了该行业可修复索赔量的部分减少。”

paras.en: According to JD Power’s 2026 U.S. Auto Claims Satisfaction Study, overall customer satisfaction decreases by 12 points (on a 1,000-point scale) due to total loss determinations, and increases by 4 points when damages are repairable.
paras.zh: 根据 JD Power 的 2026 年美国汽车索赔满意度研究，总体客户满意度因全损确定而下降 12 分（满分 1,000 分），而当损坏可修复时则增加 4 分。

paras.en: Overall, the report found that 26% of auto insurance claims were classified as total losses in 2026, up from just 16% four years ago.
paras.zh: 总体而言，该报告发现，到 2026 年，26% 的汽车保险索赔被归类为总损失，而四年前这一比例仅为 16%。

paras.en: In the Q3 LOR report, Mandell adds that average first-party deductibles are declining, down to $809 in Q3 from $844 in Q3 2025.
paras.zh: 在第三季度 LOR 报告中，Mandell 补充道，第一方平均免赔额正在下降，从 2025 年第三季度的 844 美元降至第三季度的 809 美元。

paras.en: “This may be an indicator that we are seeing more consumers switch insurance carriers as more competitive rates enter the ecosystem,” Mandell said. “This carrier switching is a catalyst for consumers to improve their coverage as they are able to attain a more favorable premium and thereby reduce their deductible or add back first-party coverages. Both of which are signs that we may see gradual increases in claims volumes in the near future.”
paras.zh: 曼德尔说：“这可能表明，随着更具竞争力的费率进入生态系统，我们看到越来越多的消费者更换保险公司。” “这种运营商转换是消费者改善保险范围的催化剂，因为他们能够获得更优惠的保费，从而减少免赔额或增加第一方保险范围。这两者都表明我们可能会在不久的将来看到索赔量逐渐增加。”

paras.en: The Q3 Quarterly Insurance Signals Intelligence Report from JD Power and TransUnion shows auto insurance carrier switching increased even though year-over-year (YoY) shopping was flat.
paras.zh: JD Power 和 TransUnion 发布的第三季度保险信号情报报告显示，尽管同比 (YoY) 购物量持平，但汽车保险公司的转换却有所增加。

paras.en: The latest report shows shopping reached 13.2% and switching 5.1%, both up 0.6 percentage points from Q2.
paras.zh: 最新报告显示，购物率达到13.2%，转换率为5.1%，均较第二季度上升0.6个百分点。

paras.en: A recent LexisNexis Risk Solutions whitepaper details survey findings on auto insurance shopping trends, stating that 72% of consumers who shopped for auto insurance are open to switching carriers. Of those, 17% said they were definitely seeking a new auto insurance company.
paras.zh: 最近的 LexisNexis Risk Solutions 白皮书详细介绍了有关汽车保险购买趋势的调查结果，指出购买汽车保险的消费者中有 72% 愿意更换保险公司。其中，17% 的人表示他们肯定正在寻找一家新的汽车保险公司。

articles.title: SCRS booth invites SEMA attendees to compete for ‘best welder’ and ‘best refinisher’
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: SEMA Show attendees are once again asked to compete in a virtual reality welding and refinishing competition to win prizes for their favorite automotive trade school at the Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) booth this week.
paras.zh: 本周，SEMA 展会的与会者再次被要求在碰撞修复专家协会 (SCRS) 展台参加虚拟现实焊接和修补漆比赛，为他们最喜欢的汽车贸易学校赢得奖品。

paras.en: From Tuesday through Friday, visitors at the SCRS booth can take part in a fully immersive welding and refinishing competition powered by Skillveri’s virtual and mixed-reality training technology. The booth is located in the Upper South Hall, Booth #31147.
paras.zh: 从周二到周五，SCRS 展位的参观者可以参加由 Skillveri 的虚拟和混合现实培训技术提供支持的完全沉浸式焊接和修补比赛。展位位于上南大厅，展位号：31147。

paras.en: The competition will sort out the “best of the best” daily from 9:30–11:30 a.m. and 1–4:30 p.m. Winners will be announced via SCRS’s Facebook and LinkedIn pages Friday afternoon.
paras.zh: 比赛将于每天上午 9:30–11:30 和下午 1–4:30 选出“最佳中的最佳”。获奖者名单将于周五下午通过 SCRS 的 Facebook 和 LinkedIn 页面公布。

paras.en: No pre-registration is needed, and it is open to students, instructors, and repair professionals. Participants can visit the SCRS booth during competition hours to compete in either the welding category, refinishing category, or both.
paras.zh: 无需预先注册，并向学生、教师和维修专业人员开放。参赛者可以在比赛期间参观 SCRS 展位，参加焊接类别、修补漆类别或两者的比赛。

paras.en: Attendees will compete for the titles of “Best Welder” and “Best Refinisher.” Finalists will receive a Full Series Pass to the 2027 SCRS Repairer Driven Education program at the SEMA Show.
paras.zh: 参加者将争夺“最佳焊工”和“最佳修补工”的称号。决赛入围者将获得 SEMA 展会上 2027 年 SCRS 维修驱动教育计划的全系列通行证。

paras.en: Each winner will also select a U.S.-based automotive trade school to receive an equipment and training package made possible by Skillveri, Southern California Collision Equipment, Milwaukee Tool, and CAR-O-LINER.
paras.zh: 每位获奖者还将选择一家位于美国的汽车贸易学校，以获得由 Skillveri、Southern California Collision Equipment、Milwaukee Tool 和 CAR-O-LINER 提供的设备和培训包。

paras.en: - First Place Welding and Refinishing Finalists: Their selected school will receive a complete Skillveri virtual and mixed-reality training system, including a lifetime software license, VR headset, specialized welding or spray painting equipment, laptop, and supporting hardware.
paras.zh: - 焊接和修补决赛第一名入围者：他们选择的学校将获得完整的 Skillveri 虚拟和混合现实培训系统，包括终身软件许可证、VR 耳机、专用焊接或喷漆设备、笔记本电脑和支持硬件。

paras.en: - Second Place Welding Finalist: Their selected school will receive a Goliath Carts Weld Test Cart and Bench Mount Combo for welding.
paras.zh: - 第二名焊接决赛入围者：他们选择的学校将获得 Goliath Carts 焊接测试车和用于焊接的台式安装组合。

paras.en: - Second Place Refinish Finalists: Their selected school will receive a Goliath Carts Painters Toolbox.
paras.zh: - 第二名修补决赛入围者：他们选择的学校将收到一个歌利亚车画家工具箱。

paras.en: - Third Place Finalists: Their selected schools will receive an extensive Milwaukee Tool equipment package featuring M12 and M18 FUEL cordless power tools, impact wrenches, ratchets, sanders, grinders, lighting, and specialty automotive repair equipment. The collection also includes extensive socket, wrench, and hand tool sets, along with a modular PACKOUT storage and organization system.
paras.zh: - 第三名决赛入围者：他们选定的学校将获得广泛的 Milwaukee Tool 设备包，其中包括 M12 和 M18 FUEL 无线电动工具、冲击扳手、棘轮、打磨机、研磨机、照明和专业汽车维修设备。该系列还包括丰富的套筒、扳手和手动工具套件，以及模块化 PACKOUT 存储和整理系统。

paras.en: - Third Place Tie: CAR-O-LINER has provided a WEL32 MIG-MAG welding machine. If no third-place tie occurs, the welding machine will be added to the first-place welding award.
paras.zh: - 第三名：CAR-O-LINER 提供了一台 WEL32 MIG-MAG 焊机。如果没有出现并列第三名的情况，则该焊机将被添加到第一名焊接奖中。

paras.en: SCRS also recently announced that members now have flexible access to the Skillveri Chroma through an exclusive rental program.
paras.zh: SCRS 最近还宣布，会员现在可以通过独家租赁计划灵活使用 Skillveri Chroma。

paras.en: The member benefit lets SCRS collision repair businesses evaluate new hires, run short-term training workshops, and build technician skills without the cost, mess, or material waste of live paint, an SCRS press release states.
paras.zh: SCRS 新闻稿称，会员福利使 SCRS 碰撞修复企业可以评估新员工、举办短期培训研讨会并培养技术人员技能，而不会产生现场油漆的成本、混乱或材料浪费。

paras.en: Next door to the SCRS booth, Spanesi is also giving away $40,000 in prizes at Booth #31173.
paras.zh: 在 SCRS 展位的隔壁，Spanesi 还在 31173 号展位赠送了 40,000 美元的奖品。

paras.en: Collision repair professionals visiting Spanesi Booth Nov. 3–6 can explore equipment and participate in an interactive experience focused on improving repair workflows and productivity, a Spanesi press release states.
paras.zh: Spanesi 新闻稿称，11 月 3 日至 6 日参观 Spanesi 展位的碰撞修复专业人员可以探索设备并参与专注于改进修复工作流程和生产力的互动体验。

paras.en: “Spanesi Collision Course transforms a traditional booth visit into a hands-on experience where attendees can explore equipment, discover practical ways to improve repair processes in their own shops, and unlock prizes along the way,” according to the release.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“Spanesi 碰撞课程将传统的展位参观转变为实践体验，参与者可以探索设备，发现改进自己商店维修流程的实用方法，并在此过程中解锁奖品。”

paras.en: Attendees scan a QR code on the show floor or at the booth to register. They then explore stations throughout the booth featuring measuring, structural repair, refinishing, and more.
paras.zh: 与会者在展会现场或展位扫描二维码进行登记。然后，他们探索整个展位的工作站，包括测量、结构修复、修补等。

paras.en: “As participants visit stations, they’ll unlock a spin on a prize wheel featuring tools, industry-related gift cards, Spanesi merch, and other prizes,” the release states.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“当参与者访问车站时，他们将解锁奖品轮盘，其中包括工具、行业相关礼品卡、Spanesi 商品和其他奖品。”

paras.en: Participants who complete all stations qualify for six prize drawings, and one winner will receive a Touch V6 Portable measuring system valued at more than $40,000. Five additional winners will each receive $1,000 in Spanesi equipment credits. Winners will be selected in on-site drawings on Friday.
paras.zh: 完成所有站的参与者有资格获得六张抽奖机会，一名获胜者将获得价值超过 40,000 美元的 Touch V6 便携式测量系统。另外五名获奖者将每人获得 1,000 美元的 Spanesi 设备积分。获奖者将于周五在现场抽奖中选出。

articles.title: Two-thirds of used car buyers concerned about undisclosed damage
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Over two-thirds of used car buyers are concerned about hidden faults or undisclosed damage, according to a new United Kingdom survey completed by Cazoo Consumer Insight Panel.
paras.zh: Cazoo Consumer Insight Panel 在英国完成的一项新调查显示，超过三分之二的二手车购买者担心隐藏的故障或未公开的损坏。

paras.en: Hidden faults or undisclosed damage was the largest concern identified in the survey of 2,025 buyers, according to Cazoo.
paras.zh: Cazoo 表示，在对 2,025 名买家进行的调查中发现，隐藏的故障或未公开的损坏是最大的担忧。

paras.en: Overall, only around a third (35.5%) of used car buyers trust dealers and more than half expect friction as part of their buying experience, the survey found. Another 16.5% said they do not trust dealers and the remaining 48% are sitting on the fence.
paras.zh: 调查发现，总体而言，只有约三分之一（35.5%）的二手车买家信任经销商，超过一半的人认为摩擦是他们购买体验的一部分。另有 16.5% 的人表示不信任经销商，其余 48% 的人持观望态度。

paras.en: Other concerns buyers have include an unclear vehicle history (45%), being overcharged (41%), and pushy sales tactics (36%).
paras.zh: 买家担心的其他问题包括车辆历史不明确（45%）、收费过高（41%）和咄咄逼人的销售策略（36%）。

paras.en: Buyers said dealers could build trust by making a full vehicle history report available (61%), including independent vehicle inspections or warranties (42%), clear no-haggle pricing (42%), and verified customer reviews (40%).
paras.zh: 买家表示，经销商可以通过提供完整的车辆历史报告（61%）来建立信任，包括独立的车辆检查或保修（42%）、明确的无讨价还价的定价（42%）和经过验证的客户评论（40%）。

paras.en: Thirty-two percent of buyers said they value dealer accreditation from a trade body and 18% value photographs or videos of dealerships.
paras.zh: 32% 的买家表示他们看重贸易机构对经销商的认证，18% 的买家看重经销商的照片或视频。

paras.en: “Our latest Consumer Insight Panel identifies the role dealers can play in recognizing how trust can address the pain points experienced by many used car buyers,” Lucy Tugby, Cazoo chief marketing officer, says in the release. “Time and again we see how the best performing used car dealers are the ones with processes in place to ensure vehicles are described accurately and sold with independent inspections and warranties.”
paras.zh: Cazoo 首席营销官露西·塔格比 (Lucy Tugby) 在新闻稿中表示：“我们最新的消费者洞察小组确定了经销商在认识到信任如何解决许多二手车购买者所经历的痛点方面可以发挥的作用。” “我们一次又一次地看到，表现最好的二手车经销商是那些拥有适当流程以确保车辆得到准确描述并在销售时经过独立检查和保修的经销商。”

paras.en: Independent inspections of used vehicles is one suggestion the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) gives to consumers who are concerned their vehicles could have a counterfeit airbag.
paras.zh: 对二手车进行独立检查是美国国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 向担心其车辆可能装有假冒安全气囊的消费者提出的一项建议。

paras.en: NHTSA identified an 11th death caused by a specific banned counterfeit airbag part in September.
paras.zh: NHTSA 于 9 月份确认了第 11 起死亡事件，原因是特定的违禁假冒安全气囊部件造成的。

paras.en: It is the first death involving one of the replacement airbag inflators installed in a Chevrolet Equinox, according to a NHTSA release. The previous 10 deaths and three serious injuries happened in Chevrolet Malibu and Hyundai Sonata vehicles.
paras.zh: 据美国国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 发布的消息，这是第一起涉及雪佛兰 Equinox 车上安装的替换安全气囊充气机的死亡事件。此前发生的 10 人死亡和 3 人重伤事故均发生在雪佛兰 Malibu 和现代 Sonata 车辆上。

paras.en: Each deadly crash involved vehicles that had the original frontal driver airbag inflators replaced with a defective and likely illegally imported inflator marked with the identifier DTN60DB, the release states.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，每起致命事故都涉及车辆将原来的正面驾驶员安全气囊充气机更换为有缺陷且可能非法进口的充气机，其标识符为 DTN60DB。

paras.en: Teena Bohi, an Automotive Anti-Counterfeiting Council (A2C2) board member, said during a Collision Industry Conference (CIC) in July that NHTSA’s investigation has uncovered how dangerous counterfeit parts find their way into vehicles.
paras.zh: 汽车反假冒委员会 (A2C2) 董事会成员 Teena Bohi 在 7 月份的碰撞行业会议 (CIC) 上表示，NHTSA 的调查发现了危险的假冒零部件是如何进入车辆的。

paras.en: “Up until the point that a counterfeit product gets installed in the vehicle, everything about it is legal,” she added.
paras.zh: “直到假冒产品安装在车上之前，一切都是合法的，”她补充道。

paras.en: The vehicles are typically fleet vehicles or self-insured vehicles that were at some point totaled, Bohi said.
paras.zh: 博希说，这些车辆通常是车队车辆或在某个时候被总计的自保车辆。

paras.en: “The totaling of a vehicle isn’t a cut-and-dried process,” Bohi says. “The value is driven depending on whether it is self-insured, the state the vehicle was in, the insurer’s own practices, processes, and thresholds. There is a lot that goes into just determining if the vehicle is totaled.”
paras.zh: “车辆的总计并不是一个现成的过程，”Bohi 说。 “该价值取决于车辆是否自我保险、车辆所处的状态、保险公司自己的做法、流程和阈值。确定车辆是否报废需要考虑很多因素。”

paras.en: Next, the vehicle often goes to an auction. If it is a public auction, an airbag deployment will possibly be reported to the National Motor Vehicle Title Information System (NMVTIS). The system is a database meant to prevent the resale of stolen vehicles and track unsafe salvage cars. If the vehicle goes to a wholesale or private auction, the previous crash information is not always captured, she said.
paras.zh: 接下来，车辆经常去拍卖。如果是公开拍卖，安全气囊的部署情况可能会报告给国家机动车辆所有权信息系统（NMVTIS）。该系统是一个数据库，旨在防止被盗车辆的转售并跟踪不安全的报废车辆。她说，如果车辆进行批发或私人拍卖，以前的碰撞信息并不总是能够被捕获。

paras.en: After the repair, vehicles are retitled, and the process can vary state to state, including the inspection process, Bohi says. Many don’t require airbag inspections.
paras.zh: 博希说，维修后，车辆将被重新命名，而且各州的流程可能有所不同，包括检查流程。许多不需要安全气囊检查。

paras.en: “There are a lot of gaps where attention could be focused that could help address these types of issues,” Bohi said.
paras.zh: 博希说：“有很多差距值得关注，这有助于解决此类问题。”

paras.en: NHTSA “urges” owners of used vehicles that have previously been in a crash since 2020 to have their vehicles inspected. It also “urges” used vehicle owners and buyers to learn their vehicle’s history and ensure it has genuine airbag inflators.
paras.zh: NHTSA“敦促”自 2020 年以来曾发生过碰撞事故的二手车车主对车辆进行检查。它还“敦促”二手车车主和买家了解其车辆的历史，并确保其配备正品安全气囊充气机。

paras.en: “If a vehicle has been in a previous crash where the air bag deployed, it should be inspected by a reputable mechanic immediately to ensure the air bag is a legitimate replacement equivalent to the original,” NHTSA says in the release. “Owners should not attempt to inspect their air bag themselves. If a vehicle is found to have a DTN60DB inflator, it should not be driven until the inflator is replaced with genuine parts.”
paras.zh: NHTSA 在新闻稿中表示：“如果车辆在之前发生过事故且安全气囊展开，则应立即由信誉良好的机械师对其进行检查，以确保安全气囊是与原始安全气囊相同的合法替代品。” “车主不应尝试自行检查安全气囊。如果发现车辆有 DTN60DB 充气机，则不应驾驶该车，除非用正品零件更换充气机。”

paras.en: Technicians looking for guidance on identifying a DTN airbag can also refer to an NHTSA document. The document outlines the materials and design characteristics that can be used to indicate whether an airbag is a counterfeit. DTN airbags are also often marked with DTN60DB. Yet, it can be hard to identify DTN airbags when they’re still installed in a vehicle.
paras.zh: 寻求识别 DTN 安全气囊指导的技术人员也可以参考 NHTSA 文件。该文件概述了可用于表明安全气囊是否为假冒产品的材料和设计特征。 DTN 安全气囊也常标有 DTN60DB。然而，当 DTN 安全气囊仍然安装在车辆上时，很难识别它们。

paras.en: Bohi said the council has reached out to the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) and the Department of Transportation (DOT) to get clarification on those processes.
paras.zh: Bohi 表示，该委员会已联系酒精、烟草、枪械和爆炸物局 (ATF) 和交通部 (DOT)，以澄清这些流程。

paras.en: “How do you safely handle these things, and what do you do if you get one? Because there are special permits to transport or get rid of these things if there is a counterfeit because we don’t know what’s in them. It’s an unknown explosive, potentially,” Bohi said.
paras.zh: “如何安全地处理这些东西？如果收到了，该怎么办？因为如果有假货，我们需要特殊许可证才能运输或销毁这些东西，因为我们不知道里面有什么。这可能是一种未知的爆炸物，”博希说。

paras.en: NHTSA’s technician guidance does offer warnings that strongly advise technicians not to electronically probe or electrify airbag connecting terminals because they can detonate and cause serious injury or death.
paras.zh: NHTSA 的技术人员指南确实提供了警告，强烈建议技术人员不要对安全气囊连接端子进行电子探测或通电，因为它们可能会爆炸并导致严重伤害或死亡。

paras.en: Bud Center, I-CAR director of technical products and curriculum, previously told Repairer Driven News that electronic probes can be used to deploy a removed airbag. However, if a repairer believes an airbag is counterfeit, they should contact the vehicle’s OEM and ask for instructions.
paras.zh: I-CAR 技术产品和课程总监 Bud Center 此前告诉 Repairer Driven News，电子探针可用于部署拆下的安全气囊。然而，如果维修人员认为安全气囊是假冒的，他们应该联系车辆的原始设备制造商并寻求指示。

paras.en: “You want to make sure you are not going to deploy something that is unsafe,” Center said.
paras.zh: “你要确保不会部署不安全的东西，”中心说。

paras.en: Center dives into the issue of counterfeit parts from the collision shop level in an I-CAR Repairers Realm series.
paras.zh: 中心在 I-CAR 维修领域系列中从碰撞车间层面深入研究假冒零件问题。

paras.en: Nearly all OEMs and many major aftermarket parts companies have people within their organizations who can answer questions concerning products, Bohi said.
paras.zh: Bohi 表示，几乎所有原始设备制造商和许多主要售后零部件公司的组织内都有可以回答有关产品问题的人员。

paras.en: If an owner has a vehicle with one of these suspect inflators, they should contact their local Homeland Security Investigations office or FBI field office to report it or submit an online complaint to the National Intellectual Property Rights Coordination Center.
paras.zh: 如果车主的车辆装有这些可疑充气机之一，他们应该联系当地的国土安全调查办公室或联邦调查局外地办事处进行报告或向国家知识产权协调中心提交在线投诉。

paras.en: Owners should also contact NHTSA online or by calling the agency’s Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236, Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Eastern time.
paras.zh: 车主还应在线联系 NHTSA 或致电该机构的车辆安全热线 888-327-4236，周一至周五上午 8 点至晚上 8 点。东部时间。

articles.title: Brake Job 101: 2004-2013 Mazda 3
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: The 2004-2013 Mazda 3 is based on the Ford global C1 platform, shared with the European Ford Focus and Volvo S40. Nothing is really groundbreaking about the mechanical brake system, but not paying attention to the details can end in a post-brake-job comeback.
paras.zh: 2004-2013年的马自达3基于福特全球C1平台，与欧洲福特福克斯和沃尔沃S40共享。机械制动系统并没有什么真正突破性的，但不注意细节可能会导致制动后卷土重来。

paras.en: A key service issue concerns the hydraulics and ABS system. The older the car, the greater the chance the brake fluid has not been serviced. Over time this can cause issues with the ABS hydraulic control unit.
paras.zh: 一个关键的服务问题涉及液压系统和 ABS 系统。汽车越旧，制动液未保养的可能性就越大。随着时间的推移，这可能会导致 ABS 液压控制单元出现问题。

paras.en: For almost 10 years, Mazda used the same caliper, pad and rotor design. Pads should be replaced when there is 2mm or less of friction material. If the rotors are any thicker, they have enough material on them to last at least one turning on the lathe. The runout specification for these vehicles is .002” and disc thickness variation should be far below .0005”.
paras.zh: 近 10 年来，马自达一直使用相同的卡钳、刹车片和转子设计。当摩擦材料有2mm以下时应更换垫片。如果转子较厚，则其上有足够的材料，足以在车床上至少转动一圈。这些车辆的跳动规格为 0.002”，盘厚度变化应远低于 0.0005”。

paras.en: Mazda claims repeated panic braking may raise the temperature in some portions of the disc plate by approx. 1,000°C (l,832°F). This temperature is almost near impossible to achieve this side of a high-speed police chase.
paras.zh: 马自达声称，反复紧急制动可能会使制动盘某些部分的温度升高约 10 度。 1,000°C (l,832°F)。这种温度对于高速警察追捕来说几乎是不可能实现的。

paras.en: The calipers mount to the brackets using caliper guide pins with Allen heads. The sleeves and boots should be disassembled, cleaned and lubricated every time the brakes are replaced. The torque for the guide pins is 21 ft./lbs. and the caliper bracket bolts should be tightened to 75 ft./lbs.
paras.zh: 使用带内六角头的卡钳导销将卡钳安装到支架上。每次更换制动器时，应将套筒和靴子拆开、清洗和润滑。导销的扭矩为 21 英尺/磅。卡钳支架螺栓应拧紧至 75 英尺/磅。

paras.en: All Mazda3 models have rear disc brakes. The calipers mount to the brackets using caliper guide pins with Allen heads. The sleeves and boots should be disassembled, cleaned and lubricated every time the brakes are replaced. The torque for the guide pins is 21 ft./lbs. and the caliper bracket bolts should be tightened to 55 ft./lbs.
paras.zh: 所有 Mazda3 车型均配备后盘式制动器。使用带内六角头的卡钳导销将卡钳安装到支架上。每次更换制动器时，应将套筒和靴子拆开、清洗和润滑。导销的扭矩为 21 英尺/磅。卡钳支架螺栓应拧紧至 55 英尺/磅。

paras.en: Mazda uses a hand brake that is incorporated into the rear caliper, and a couple of systems are employed to retract rear pistons. The later-model cars require the familiar method of turning the piston clockwise while applying pressure, where others will have a plug on the back side of the caliper that provides access for an Allen wrench to facilitate retracting the piston. Be careful as you retract the piston.
paras.zh: 马自达使用集成在后卡钳中的手制动器，并采用几个系统来缩回后活塞。后期型号的汽车需要采用熟悉的方法，在施加压力的同时顺时针转动活塞，而其他型号的汽车则在卡钳的背面有一个塞子，为内六角扳手提供了通道，以便于缩回活塞。缩回活塞时要小心。

paras.en: After the pads are replaced, pump the pedal and adjust the parking brake mechanism in the rear calipers. If the level has too much travel, perform the following steps:
paras.zh: 更换刹车片后，踩下踏板并调整后卡钳中的驻车制动机构。如果水平仪行程太大，请执行以下步骤：

paras.en: - Remove the service hole cover of the rear console.
paras.zh: - 拆下后控制台的维修孔盖。

paras.en: - Turn the adjusting nut and adjust the parking brake lever.
paras.zh: - 转动调节螺母并调节驻车制动杆。

paras.en: - After adjustment, pull the parking brake lever one notch and verify that the parking brake warning light illuminates and the rear brakes do not drag.
paras.zh: - 调整后，将驻车制动杆拉一档，并确认驻车制动警告灯亮起且后制动器不拖曳。

paras.en: The Mazda3 comes in two styles, ABS and ABS with Dynamic Stability Control (DSC). Both systems connect to other vehicle components via a high-speed serial data bus. The DSC system ties more components together (like a yaw/pitch sensor and steering position sensor) onto the bus.
paras.zh: Mazda3 有两种类型：ABS 和带动态稳定控制 (DSC) 的 ABS。两个系统都通过高速串行数据总线连接到其他车辆组件。 DSC 系统将更多组件（如偏航/俯仰传感器和转向位置传感器）连接到总线上。

paras.en: If you are seeing communication-related DTCs, it is essential that you fully diagnose problems with the system before you start replacing sensors and modules. Some of these vehicles have been on the road for more than six years and the connections will be starting to corrode and fret.
paras.zh: 如果您看到与通信相关的 DTC，则在开始更换传感器和模块之前必须全面诊断系统问题。其中一些车辆已经在路上行驶了六年多，连接处将开始腐蚀和磨损。

paras.en: One of the main facilitators of ABS/DCS problems are the connectors, especially under the hood where the control/modulator unit connects. Being able to measure values at the connectors and observe data on a scan tool is essential for diagnosing problems.
paras.zh: ABS/DCS 问题的主要推动因素之一是连接器，尤其是在控制/调制器单元连接的引擎盖下。能够测量连接器处的值并观察扫描工具上的数据对于诊断问题至关重要。

paras.en: The biggest ABS issue with the three generations of Mazda 3 is power. With some higher mileage vehicles, the battery cables, wiring from the power distribution box or the ground connection (behind the driver’s side headlight at G02) can have enough resistance so the voltage drops below 8 volts. When this happens, the ABS module cuts control and the electronic brake distribution system is disabled.
paras.zh: 三代马自达3的ABS最大的问题就是动力。对于一些里程较高的车辆，电池电缆、配电箱接线或接地连接（G02 处驾驶员侧前灯后面）可能具有足够的电阻，因此电压降至 8 伏以下。发生这种情况时，ABS 模块会切断控制，电子制动分配系统将被禁用。

paras.en: If a modulator/control unit is replaced, the pressure sensors must be recalibrated with a scan tool that is able to communicate with the chassis/ABS module. If this is not performed, it can result in brake failure and lock up.
paras.zh: 如果更换调制器/控制单元，则必须使用能够与底盘/ABS 模块通信的扫描工具重新校准压力传感器。如果不执行此操作，可能会导致制动失灵和锁止。

paras.en: If you have DTCs C1141, C1142, C1143, C1144, C1233, C1234, C1235 or C1236 (ABS wheel-speed sensor/ABS sensor rotor), chances are something is wrong with the wheel bearings. Another cause for these codes could be an accumulation of metal debris on the sensor. The front bearings are press-in cartridge-style units. Rear wheel bearings are hub units. In the front, the tone ring, or encoder, is on the inner seal of the bearing and the sensor is mounted in the knuckle. The parameters for these codes to be set include abnormalities in the signal such as a weak signal or large differences in the value when compared to the other sensors.
paras.zh: 如果您有 DTC C1141、C1142、C1143、C1144、C1233、C1234、C1235 或 C1236（ABS 轮速传感器/ABS 传感器转子），则车轮轴承可能出现问题。造成这些代码的另一个原因可能是传感器上金属碎片的堆积。前轴承是压入式盒式单元。后轮轴承是轮毂单元。在前面，音环或编码器位于轴承的内密封件上，传感器安装在转向节中。要设置的这些代码的参数包括信号异常，例如信号较弱或与其他传感器相比值存在较大差异。

paras.en: If you have DTCs C1145, C1155, C1165 or C1175 (open sensor), it could be damaged wiring or a failed sensor that is the problem. If you have more than one, chances are there is a problem with the connection at the control unit or in the front or rear harnesses of the sensors.
paras.zh: 如果您有 DTC C1145、C1155、C1165 或 C1175（传感器开路），则问题可能是接线损坏或传感器故障。如果您有多个，则控制单元或传感器前后线束的连接可能存在问题。

paras.en: These DTCs will usually clear themselves after repairs are made and the vehicle is driven above 6.2 mph when the self-diagnostic check is performed.
paras.zh: 这些 DTC 通常会在维修后自行清除，并且在执行自诊断检查时车辆行驶速度高于 6.2 英里/小时。

paras.en: Some customers may report a slight clunk, bang or jolt from the front of the vehicle. This concern will most likely occur during the vehicle’s first forward movement and after the vehicle sits for a few hours and/or a cold soak. This is a normal operating noise of the ABS system.
paras.zh: 一些客户可能会报告车辆前部发出轻微的沉闷声、撞击声或摇晃声。这种问题很可能发生在车辆第一次向前移动期间以及车辆停放几个小时和/或冷浸之后。这是 ABS 系统的正常工作噪音。

paras.en: If you encounter a customer complaint for this concern, explain that the noise comes from the ABS/TCS/DSC “Malfunction Detection Function” initial check. The initial check is a necessary function to ensure the normal operation of the ABS/TCS/DSC system. This initial test function occurs during the vehicle’s first forward movement and when the vehicle reaches approximately 6.2 mph.
paras.zh: 如果您遇到客户对此问题的投诉，请解释噪音来自 ABS/TCS/DSC“故障检测功能”初始检查。初始检查是保证ABS/TCS/DSC系统正常工作的必要功能。该初始测试功能发生在车辆第一次向前移动且时速达到约 6.2 英里/小时时。

articles.title: Dipstick Replacement Sensors: How They Work
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: GM has taken a lot of guff recently for eliminating the dipstick on some of their newer V8 engines and replacing it with a sensor. Let’s talk about how those sensors actually work, and how and when they measure the oil level.
paras.zh: 通用汽车公司最近因取消一些较新的 V8 发动机上的量油尺并用传感器取代而受到了很多批评。让我们谈谈这些传感器的实际工作原理，以及它们如何以及何时测量油位。

paras.en: It’s not like, for example, a brake master cylinder that has a float and a level that turns on the light on the dash when it reaches a certain level. These sensors are ultrasonic. In other words, it’s sending out a sound wave into the oil pan and determining the oil level that way.
paras.zh: 例如，它不像具有浮子和水平仪的制动主缸，当达到一定水平时，仪表板上的灯会打开。这些传感器是超声波传感器。换句话说，它向油底壳发出声波并以此方式确定油位。

paras.en: How does it know when to measure the level of oil in the oil pan? If you’re using a dipstick, the vehicle would be parked, it probably wouldn’t be running, and that’s when you’re checking the oil level. The sensor works the same way: It’s only measuring the oil level at certain instances. Let’s say it’s in Park when you first start up. Let’s say you’re sitting at a traffic light; that is when it’s measuring the level.
paras.zh: 它如何知道何时测量油底壳中的油位？如果您使用量油尺，车辆将被停放，可能不会运行，此时您需要检查油位。传感器的工作方式相同：它仅在某些情况下测量油位。假设您第一次启动时位于公园。假设您正坐在红绿灯前；那是它测量液位的时候。

paras.en: For more on sensors and how they work, including oxygen and TPMS sensors, watch the video above.
paras.zh: 有关传感器及其工作原理（包括氧气和 TPMS 传感器）的更多信息，请观看上面的视频。

paras.en: This video is sponsored by Auto Value and Bumper To Bumper.
paras.zh: 该视频由 Auto Value 和 Bumper To Bumper 赞助。

articles.title: Corey Bartlett Wins AWDA’s Excellence in Education Award
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: The Aftermarket Warehouse Distributors Association (AWDA), a community of the Auto Care Association, presented the 2026 Art Fisher Award for Excellence in Education, to Corey Bartlett, CEO of Auto Parts Headquarters (APH) based in St. Cloud, MN. The award was presented on November 1st by AWDA Vice Chair Young Suhr at AWDA’s 2026 Annual Conference in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: 汽车护理协会下属的售后仓库分销商协会 (AWDA) 向位于明尼苏达州圣克劳德的汽车零部件总部 (APH) 首席执行官科里·巴特利特 (Corey Bartlett) 颁发了 2026 年 Art Fisher 卓越教育奖。该奖项于 11 月 1 日由 AWDA 副主席 Young Suhr 在拉斯维加斯举行的 AWDA 2026 年年会上颁发。

paras.en: AWDA’s Art Fisher Award for Excellence in Education is presented annually to an aftermarket company or individual that demonstrates outstanding commitment to education and training, either within their organization or throughout the industry. Given in memory of former AWDA Chairman Art Fisher, the award grants scholarships in the name of the award winner to two students enrolled in the automotive aftermarket management program at Northwood University.
paras.zh: AWDA 的 Art Fisher 卓越教育奖每年颁发给在其组织内或整个行业内表现出对教育和培训做出杰出承诺的售后公司或个人。为了纪念 AWDA 前主席 Art Fisher，该奖项以获奖者的名义向诺斯伍德大学汽车售后市场管理项目的两名学生提供奖学金。

paras.en: Corey Bartlett has shown a unique interest in education from the day he began working professionally for APH. Within his first ten years, he reorganized staff and increased training for employees. Leading by example, he himself completed the University of the Aftermarket’s Leadership 2010 at Ohio State University, and he earned his AAP and MAAP designations at the University of the Aftermarket in 2002 and 2009 respectively.
paras.zh: 从科里·巴特利特 (Corey Bartlett) 开始在 APH 专业工作的那天起，他就表现出了对教育的独特兴趣。在他上任的头十年里，他重组了员工并加强了对员工的培训。他以身作则，于 2010 年在俄亥俄州立大学完成了售后市场大学领导力课程，并分别于 2002 年和 2009 年在售后市场大学获得了 AAP 和 MAAP 称号。

paras.en: “Corey has shown incredible initiative in supporting training and continuing education,” said John R. Washbish, president and CEO of the Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance, Inc. “Through his leadership roles and example, he has consistently improved the education and standards of his staff, the Alliance, and the industry as a whole.”
paras.zh: 售后汽车零部件联盟总裁兼首席执行官 John R. Washbish 表示：“科里在支持培训和继续教育方面表现出了令人难以置信的主动性。通过他的领导作用和榜样，他不断提高员工、联盟以及整个行业的教育和标准。”

paras.en: Now as CEO, Bartlett primarily oversees the operations of the business and has continued to emphasize education. As the company expanded to include medium, heavy duty, and agricultural aspects, Bartlett and his managers developed a 101 class to further educate his staff about the new aspects of the business. He partnered with a local technical college to provide hands-on experience, and the company saw nearly 100% participation among its 1,200 employees.
paras.zh: 现在，作为首席执行官，巴特利特主要负责监督业务运营，并继续强调教育。随着公司业务扩展到中型、重型和农业领域，Bartlett 和他的经理们开发了 101 课程，以进一步教育员工了解业务的新方面。他与当地一所技术学院合作，提供实践经验，公司 1,200 名员工的参与率接近 100%。

paras.en: While serving as board liaison of the Alliance’s Sales & Marketing Committee, Bartlett oversaw the group’s scholarship program and helped create the Technician of the Year program.
paras.zh: 在担任联盟销售与营销委员会的董事会联络员期间，巴特利特负责监督该集团的奖学金计划，并帮助创建了年度技术员计划。

paras.en: Outside of the Alliance and APH, Bartlett has chaired the Automotive Warehouse Distributors Association (AWDA) Board of Governors, serves as a mentor for the Young Auto Care Networking Group (YANG), and has been a generous supporter and active proponent of the Auto Care Political Action Committee since 2015. He was named the AWDA Pursuit of Excellence honoree in 2017.
paras.zh: 除了联盟和 APH 之外，巴特利特还担任汽车仓库经销商协会 (AWDA) 理事会主席、青年汽车护理网络团体 (YANG) 的导师，并且自 2015 年以来一直是汽车护理政治行动委员会的慷慨支持者和积极支持者。他于 2017 年被评为 AWDA 追求卓越奖得主。

paras.en: Bartlett is involved in his local community, enthusiastically supporting WACOSA – a nonprofit organization that helps adults with disabilities connect with local businesses – through Chili Cook Off efforts with his father, and opening up APH facilities for use by local nonprofits.
paras.zh: Bartlett 积极参与当地社区活动，通过与父亲一起开展 Chili Cook Off 活动，热情支持 WCOSA（一家帮助残疾人与当地企业建立联系的非营利组织），并开放 APH 设施供当地非营利组织使用。
